Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido.

Who will you be working with?

We are seeking a One Stream Reporting and Controls Analyst to join our team. You will collaborate with the finance, IT, and compliance teams to deliver accurate and reliable financial reports while also contributing to efforts that maintain and improve our IT control framework for financial reporting. This position is ideal for someone interested in combining technical skills with financial reporting and compliance work.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the IT Finance Systems Team, you will be responsible for:

  • Report Development: Assist in the creation, customization, and maintenance of financial reports, including retrieving, grids, queries, and other dashboard reporting functions. Ensure that reports are accurate and meet business requirements for various financial periods (monthly, quarterly, annually).
  • Financial Data Accuracy: Verify and validate financial data across OneStream reports, ensuring data integrity and resolving discrepancies by working with end-users and technical teams.
  • SOX Compliance Support: Contribute to the documentation and maintenance of IT SOX controls related to OneStream and financial reporting processes. Help ensure compliance with internal controls, segregation of duties, and security standards throughout the system.
  • Audit Support: Assist in IT audits by preparing required documentation, conducting control testing, and helping auditors with their review of financial reporting systems and controls.
  • Process Improvement: Collaborate with finance and IT teams to identify and implement improvements to the reporting processes. Support the continuous enhancement of financial systems to increase efficiency and accuracy.
  • User Support and Training: Provide support for end users by troubleshooting report-related issues and offering guidance on report usage. Assist with training sessions to ensure users are proficient with OneStream’s reporting capabilities.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for OneStream reports, IT controls, audit activities, and financial reporting processes.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, identify process improvements, and ensure reporting capabilities align with business needs and compliance requirements.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in information systems, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Proven experience working with reporting tools such as OneStream, Power BI or similar financial systems reporting tools in a reporting or compliance role.
  • Basic understanding of SOX compliance and IT audit controls.
  • Experience with financial report writing and data analysis tools such as Microsoft Power BI or similar reporting software.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Office applications.

What will your typical day look like?

In this role, your day will be dynamic and engaging, involving a mix of technical and collaborative tasks.

  • You will start by developing and customizing financial reports to meet business requirements for various financial periods.
  • Throughout the day, you'll verify and validate financial data, ensuring accuracy and resolving any discrepancies by working closely with end-users and technical teams.
  • You will also contribute to maintaining IT SOX controls and supporting IT audits by preparing documentation and conducting control testing.
  • Additionally, you'll collaborate with finance and IT teams to identify and implement process improvements, provide user support and training, and create comprehensive documentation for financial reporting processes.
  • Your day will be filled with opportunities to enhance reporting capabilities and ensure compliance with business needs and IT governance standards.

title: Marketing para arquitetos, linha zero
description:
Muitos escritórios de arquitetura, urbanismo e design que entram em contato conosco pedem informações sobre “como fazer marketing”. Aprofundando a conversa, logo percebemos que o desejo é, na verdade, saber como construir planos de comunicação e estratégias de captação de novos clientes. Falaremos sobre isso por aqui em breve, mas antes é importante deixar claro o que é marketing de fato, até porque essas empresas já investem (e muito!) em ferramentas de marketing e nem percebem.

Repare que o termo “marketing” não é (bem) traduzido para nossa língua. E quando se usa “mercadologia” (algo como “estudo do mercado”), o assunto deveria ser completamente diferente, pois o sentido é outro. As palavras terminadas em “ing” em inglês podem denotar atividades, ações, comportamento ativo em relação ao objeto. Assim como “surfing” não é o estudo do surf, nem “bowling” seria o estudo do boliche (mas sim a sua prática ), da mesma forma, marketing significa um conjunto de conhecimentos, ferramentas e técnicas para agir no mercado otimizando as relações de troca da organização .

O marketing também não se limita à propaganda, é muito mais do que isso, onde a comunicação com o mercado é consequência de um planejamento maior com grande aderência à estratégia do escritório , e tem forte conexão com todos os aspectos gerenciais: financeiro, operacional, gestão de pessoas e inclui o desenho de produtos (bens ou serviços) oferecidos ao mercado. A propaganda é apenas uma entre quatro principais ferramentas (composto de marketing).

Através de ferramentas de marketing, o escritório diz a seu mercado o que significa sua existência, qual o seu posicionamento em relação à concorrência, que valor é oferecido, e por que o cliente deveria nos escolher em vez de nossos concorrentes.

O mais interessante para nós, é que trabalhamos quase que o tempo todo em marketing, seja para o nosso ou de nosso cliente, sem saber. Isso acontece porque das quatro principais ferramentas do composto de marketing, uma é o desenvolvimento de produtos : justamente o coração de nossa atividade profissional. Para escritórios de design então, esta relação é ainda mais direta, com a produção de design de marcas e de peças de comunicação com o mercado.

Outra das quatro principais ferramentas também é utilizada por nós constantemente sem a atenção enquanto ação de marketing: o preço. Além de se refletir em nosso ganha-pão, é uma das mais importantes formas de se comunicar com o mercado , pois diz ao potencial cliente o quanto de benefícios acreditamos estar propondo entregar (valor). Cada proposta comercial encaminhada é uma ação de marketing muito importante.

É essencial termos consciência da inter-relação entre os pontos de comunicação e de contato com o mercado, pois todos devem estar alinhados, serem coerentes entre si e refletir o objetivo estratégico do escritório. Tudo isso deve estar previsto em um plano de negócios coerente e viável.

description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Survey Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Survey (Mar) discipline within McDermott.   • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Land or Hydrography Survey, Marine Science, Geomatics, or a related field
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in land and marine surveying within the EPCI industry, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects
  • Strong knowledge of relevant industry regulations, standards, and guidelines e.g., IMCA and/or International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) standards, Marine Spatial Planning (MSP), and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices
  • Proficient in using industry-standard survey equipment and software, including GPS, GNSS, Single/Multibeam Echosounders, various survey sensors, geophysical survey equipment, and new tech photogrammetry and scanning surveying techniques
  • Familiar with Mapping software like AutoCAD, Global Mapper, GIS, tidal and bathymetry software
  • In-depth knowledge of land marine survey methodologies using ROVs and Installation Vessels, data processing, and quality/safety control techniques
  • Strong understanding of subsea infrastructure, offshore construction, and installation processes
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented and analytical mindset, with a high level of accuracy and precision in survey data analysis and reporting
  • Up-to-date certifications in relevant surveying technologies (e.g., Land and Hydrographic Surveying, Subsea Positioning) are an added advantage
  • A proactive and curious attitude, continuously seeking improvement and innovation in land and marine survey practices
  • Ability to work in challenging onshore and offshore environments and adapt to variable working conditions and schedules

#LI-AM1

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct precise and comprehensive land and marine surveys, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations
  • Lead and oversee all survey activities within the EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation) projects, providing expert guidance and support to the project team
  • Utilize advanced surveying equipment, software, and techniques to accurately collect and analyze marine and land survey data, including bathymetry, geophysical data, and subsea infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and clients to define survey requirements, objectives, and deliverables for each project phase
  • Plan, organize, and execute survey operations, such as pre-installation surveys, subsea positioning, route surveys, and as-laid/as-built surveys while ensuring compliance with project specifications
  • Manage and interpret survey data and prepare detailed reports, charts, and visual representations, highlighting findings, anomalies, and potential obstacles
  • Conduct quality control checks on all survey data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout the project lifecycle
  • Develop and maintain survey documentation, and survey equipment readiness, manage and coordinate survey-related contractors or business partners
  • Abreast with the latest advancements in land and marine survey technologies, methodologies, and regulations, and propose innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy
  • Mentor and train junior survey team members, fostering their professional growth and ensuring adherence to best practices and safety protocols
  • To be based at worksite based on project requirements, onshore and/or offshore

Sumário

Analista de Laboratório Sr, com experiencia mínima de 4 anos em Controle de Qualidade de Industria Farmacêutica ou Veterinária.

Responsável por executar análises físico químicas de matérias prima, produtos intermediários e acabados, a fim de atender as demandas planejadas com as áreas de produção, planejamento e projetos.

Deve auxiliar colegas no atendimento da demanda da área e de projetos e executar as atividades de acordo com as normas de segurança e boas praticas de laboratório conforme definido nos procedimentos operacionais padrões, JSA e metodologias.

Necessário Inglês nível Intermediário (desejável nível avançado), ter conhecimento e aplicabilidade de BPL, 5S e Lean Lab.

Responsabilidades

  1. Aplica e lidera iniciativas Lean Lab;
  2. Executa ações propostas e propõe mudanças no laboratório (abre CM – controle de mudanças);
  3. Preenche fichas de análise e logbooks do laboratório, realiza duplo check, registra monitoramentos de temperatura, umidade, pressão de equipamentos e salas;
  4. Aplica e lidera iniciativas de 5S e organiza a área de trabalho, reagentes, soluções padrões e periféricos dos equipamentos, visando a conservação e manutenção adequada dos mesmos, a fim de realizar as análises conforme método estabelecido;
  5. Prover com documentos, investiga, propõe CAPA e conclui Desvios/LIR;
  6. Requisita materiais específicos do Laboratório e controla estoque;
  7. Limpeza e organização dos Laboratórios;
  8. Separa materiais e executa análises de alta complexidade (análise que exige manipulação e experiência na interpretação) e capacita os analistas de laboratório Jr e Pl;
  9. Cumprimento de Compliance e Integridade de Dados;
  10. Propõe melhorias nas análises;
  11. Acompanha validade das calibrações e certificações de equipamentos;
  12. Recebimento de materiais, amostras e preparo de soluções;
  13. Descarte de resíduos;
  14. Atendimento das normas de Biossegurança e GLP;
  15. Participa de treinamentos, eventos e campanhas de EHS e Qualidade;
  16. Comunica situações de riscos à área de EHS, conforme os programas;
  17. Previne atos inseguros no desempenho do trabalho, seguindo as recomendações conforme procedimentos de cada área;
  18. Usa e zela pelos EPI's - Equipamentos de Proteção Individual, disponibilizados para função;
  19. Zela pelo bom estado dos equipamentos da área sob sua responsabilidade;
  20. Zela pela confidencialidade das informações sob sua responsabilidade;
  21. Cumpre normas de BPF estabelecidas pela empresa;
  22. Cumpre as normas e regulamentos contidos no Código de Conduta da empresa.

Qualificações

Graduação nos cursos de Farmácia, Química ou correlatas preferencialmente;

Sólida experiência em laboratórios de controle de qualidade de indústria farmacêutica/veterinária preferencialmente;

Inglês intermediário imprescindível, avançado é desejável.

Requisitos e Habilidades Técnicas

  1. Conhecimento das normas de Biossegurança e GLP;
  2. Experiência em análises físico-químicas;
  3. Conhecimento técnico (teórico e prático) em técnicas convencionais como titulação, espectrofotometria, dentre outras aplicadas à análises de Produto Acabado e matéria-prima;
  4. Possuir sólidos conhecimentos nas técnicas de HPLC e GC;
  5. Desejável habilidade nos seguintes sistemas: Pacote MS-Office, ZLIMS, MODA, ETS;
  6. Habilidade de Comunicação Escrita (domínio da linguagem escrita, ausência de erros gramaticais na produção textual, habilidade de desenvolver textos claros e concisos e empregar adequadamente o vocabulário técnico nas produções textuais);
  7. Habilidade de Comunicação Oral (domínio da linguagem verbal, ausência de erros de concordância verbal, habilidade de falar com clareza e objetividade e habilidade de empregar termos técnicos na comunicação);
  8. Habilidade para trabalho em equipe.

Horário de Trabalho: 16:15 às 01:28

Descrição da empresa

A Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) é uma empresa global de soluções em ciência de materiais e identificação digital. Estamos Making Possible produtos e soluções que ajudam a promover os setores que atendemos, fornecendo soluções de marca e informação que otimizam a eficiência da mão de obra e da cadeia de suprimentos, reduzem o desperdício, promovem a sustentabilidade, a circularidade e a transparência e conectam melhor as marcas e os consumidores. Nós projetamos e desenvolvemos materiais de etiquetagem e funcionais, inner layers e etiquetas de identificação por radiofrequência (RFID), aplicativos de software que conectam o físico e o digital, e ofertas que aprimoram embalagens de marca e transportam ou exibem informações que melhoram a experiência do cliente. Atendendo setores em todo o mundo — incluindo cuidados pessoais e domésticos, vestuário, varejo em geral, comércio eletrônico, logística, alimentos e mantimentos, produtos farmacêuticos e automotivos — empregamos aproximadamente 35.000 funcionários em mais de 50 países. Nossas vendas reportadas em 2024 foram de US$ 8,8 bilhões. Saiba mais em .

Descrição da vaga

A Avery Dennison está procurando um Analista de Negócios de TI com experiência em implementação e suporte de ERP, com foco em Cadeia de Suprimentos e Estoque. Como parte da Organização Global de TI, esta posição será um elo fundamental entre as equipes de TI, Operações, Cadeia de Suprimentos e Liderança.

É necessário um histórico que inclua gerenciamento de projetos de TI, um entendimento técnico da estrutura de ERP e conceitos de processos de manufatura.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estabelecer e manter um forte relacionamento de trabalho com nossos principais líderes de negócios.
  • Compreender claramente as necessidades de negócios, complexidades e impacto das mudanças técnicas.
  • Impulsionar a melhoria contínua de nossas práticas, procedimentos e ferramentas de suporte de TI.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar lacunas nas operações de negócios e apoiar o design e implementação de mudanças no sistema de TI, alinhadas à estratégia geral de TI.
  • Apoiar a implementação de sistemas ERP.
  • Identificar e apresentar oportunidades para soluções técnicas e melhoria de processos.

Qualificações

  • Diploma de bacharel, idealmente com especialização em TI, Administração de Empresas ou Ciência da Computação, é obrigatório.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação em inglês, tanto escritas quanto verbais.
  • Pelo menos 3 anos ou mais de experiência fundamental como Analista de Negócios, idealmente na indústria de manufatura, em projetos relacionados a processos de cadeia de suprimentos ou operações.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas e implementações de ERP. Preferencialmente Oracle EBS ou Fusion.
  • Forte conhecimento em conceitos de banco de dados relacionais.
  • Conhecimento de SQL e PL/SQL.
  • Certificação APICS é uma vantagem.
  • Certificação CBAP é uma vantagem.
  • Experiência em (Lean) Six Sigma e/ou Gerenciamento de Projetos é altamente desejável.
  • Sólido conhecimento de mapeamento e otimização de processos.
  • Capacidade de planejar estrategicamente, bem como traduzir em plano de implementação para a organização.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas, capacidade de criar soluções sofisticadas para requisitos complexos.

Informações adicionais

Todas as pessoas qualificadas receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência, status de veterano protegido ou outro status protegido. title: XP Future | Transição de Carreira | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.

Our Vision.

SBM Offshore believes the oceans will provide the world with safe, sustainable and affordable energy for generations to come. We share our experience to make it happen.

Our Profile.

We design, build, install and operate offshore floating facilities for the offshore energy industry. As a leading technology provider, we put our marine expertise at the service of a responsible energy transition by reducing emissions from fossil fuel production while developing cleaner solutions for renewable energy sources. More than 7,000 SBMers worldwide are committed to sharing their experience to deliver safe, sustainable and affordable energy from the oceans for generations to come. Together, we are driving progress forward in a TRUE.BLUE.TRANSITION.

Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for the execution of NR-13 standard scope of all equipment controlled by company’s SPIE “Own Service of Equipment Inspection”, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, quality assurance and quality control of subcontractors, and development and improvement of preventive and predictive maintenance plans, in order to ensure and maximize asset reliability, availability, maintainability, safety and integrity.
  2. Ensure legal compliance, regulatory requirements and keep SPIE certification through integrity management system, preparation, implementation, and monitoring of inspection plans of controlled equipment, organization of NR-13 and SPIE related activities with Equipment Inspector.
  3. Define inspection techniques (conventional and non-conventional) to guarantee the physical integrity of NR-13 standard scope. Implement new inspection technologies, including methodologies, special tests, engineering studies, etc., ensuring the effective application and suitable to the company expectation.
  4. Analyze the in-service equipment structural integrity through inspections and nondestructive tests, assessment for fitness for service or risk-based inspection to determine if the equipment is fit for continued service.
  5. Contribute for the definition if an equipment has or not condition to operate satisfactorily to ensure operational reliability by participating in decisions or developing technical studies and informing the involved ones of the results of inspection reports, repairs or replacements recommended to restore the physical conditions in satisfactory levels.
  6. Follow up, monitor, and guide all activities of internal and external inspectors in the execution of their activities, so that they act in accordance with SBM’s integrity management system.
  7. Sporadic embarks in the operational units might be required for these activities to comply with local requirements.
  8. Prepare, review, and approve inspection records, ensuring that they are conclusive in accordance with the company procedures, standards, integrity management system, legislation, INMETRO ordinances for SPIE attendance.
  9. Preparation, review and/or approve the project of alteration and repair “PAR” of controlled equipment, defining analyzes tests and necessary measurements to assure the quality of them and to meet the legal and design requirements.

Job Requirements

  1. Degree qualification in Mechanical Engineering.
  2. Experience in Non-destructive inspection, with a significant piping materials/corrosion background.
  3. Good sense of economics and good analytical skills.
  4. Excellent communication, planning, and organizing skills.
  5. Fluent or Advanced English.

title: Senior Observability Specialist
description:
Company Description

Are you passionate about digital, data, IoT or AI and want to help a dynamic and ambitious team on a human scale?

Talan is an international advisory group on innovation and transformation through technology, with 5000 employees, and a turnover of 600M€.

We offer our customers a continuum of services to support you at each key stage of your organization's transformation, with 4 main activities:

Consulting: in management and innovation: supporting business, managerial, cultural, and technological transformations.
Data & Technology: to implement major transformation projects.
Cloud & Application Services: to build or integrate software solutions.
Service Centers of Excellence: to support the latter through technology, innovation, agility, sustainability of skills and cost optimization.

Talan accelerates its clients' transformation through innovation and technology. By understanding their challenges, with our support, innovation, technology and data, we enable them to be more efficient and resilient.

We believe that only a human-oriented practice of technology will make the new digital age an era of progress for all. Together let's commit!

Job Description

Main Tasks:

  • As an observability specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of our organization's systems and services.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to understand the requirements for observability and monitoring of their services.
  • You will work closely with our development and operations teams to design, implement, and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions that enable us to identify and resolve issues quickly.
  • Enable and leverage the observability practice.
  • Act as a fellow squad member.
  • Promote and leverage the near-zero manual actions in the administration and upgrade of systems, together with the development of incident automatic responses.
  • Design, implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Jaeger, etc.
  • Leverage the monitoring processes so they map the underlying business processes they support.
  • Ensure that observability and monitoring systems are set up to provide actionable insights that can be used to improve system stability, performance, and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to observability systems, including data quality, system availability, and performance.
  • Continuously evaluate new and emerging observability technologies and tools, and make recommendations for their adoption.
  • Develop and maintain documentation on observability systems and procedures.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Solid knowledge in public clouds: AWS, Azure, GCP.
  • Experience with tools such as Dynatrace (Required), Netcool, Devo, Netscout, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Jaeger, etc.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience in dealing with large data sets.
  • Basic knowledge about Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
  • Proficient in English language.
  • Understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Permanent, full-time contract.
  • Smart Office Pack so that you can work comfortably from home.
  • Training and career development.
  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and travel cards as part of the flexible remuneration package.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
  • Hybrid position, based in Málaga. Relocation is mandatory.
  • Possibility to manage work permits.

If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you.

title: Grants Proposal Manager
description:
Grants Proposal Manager
Arlington VA (DC) – Onsite 3 days per week
Job Summary:
The Grants Proposal Manager will oversee the end-to-end process of preparing and submitting compliant grant applications to federal agencies (NIH, NSF, DOE, CDC, AHRQ) and major private foundations (e.g., Gates Foundation, Pew Charitable Trusts). This role collaborates closely with principal investigators and internal teams to ensure timely, accurate, and policy-compliant submissions using platforms like NIH ASSIST and Grants.gov. Responsibilities include managing proposal components, improving submission processes, maintaining internal documentation, and providing training on grant systems and requirements.
Responsibilities:
  • Grant Management – Manages the coordination and submission of moderately complex grant applications. Works with principal investigators, division staff, grants administrators, pricing analysts and administrative teams to compile technical, budgetary, and administrative components. Provides guidance to principal investigators on interpreting and meeting submission requirements and instructions. Ensures proposals are submitted in compliance with sponsor requirements and in a timely manner, with limited oversight.
  • Proposal Support Materials – Assists with customizing and updating biosketches, current and pending support documents, facilities descriptions, and other required grant attachments. Maintains internal templates, boilerplate and document libraries for use across submissions.
  • Grants Process Improvements – Supports the development, documentation, and maintenance of standard operating procedures, templates, and checklists for grant submissions. Contributes to continuous process improvement and documentation efforts.
  • Training and Professional Development – Participates in training and process development efforts for research teams and PDS staff on grant-related topics such as sponsor systems, updates to submission policies, and institutional processes. Attends professional development opportunities and stays up to date on changes within the various grant-making federal agencies to which our company applies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Works closely with pricing analysts, grants administrators, research and analysis staff, division leadership, external affairs, and other teams to ensure seamless coordination of grant applications and post-submission requirements.
  • System and Recordkeeping – Ensures submission records and supporting documents are maintained in appropriate institutional systems, including CRM or grant management tools as applicable.
  • Technical Assistance – Provides guidance to proposal team members and research teams on sponsor systems such as NIH ASSIST, eRA Commons, and Grants.gov Workspace.

Required Qualifications:
  • 4+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of grant submissions, particularly for federal agencies (NIH, NSF).
  • Proficiency with grant submission platforms such as NIH ASSIST, Grants.gov, and eRA Commons.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with diverse proposal teams.
  • Familiarity with various funding mechanisms (grants, contracts, cooperative agreements).

Preferred (Nice to Have):
  • Experience with enterprise CRM or grant management systems.
  • Understanding of federal acquisition regulations (FAR, DFAR) and contract pricing models (T&M, CPFF, FFP).
  • Knowledge of budget development and pricing strategies for grant proposals.
  • Experience supporting major private foundation submissions.
  • Prior experience delivering training or process improvement initiatives related to grant submissions.

About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

About the Role

We are looking for a Fraud Data Analyst to work directly with our customers on our Merchant Health Team. You will be part of a growing analytics team that is responsible for Riskified’s customers’ performance and online fraud prevention using quick problem-solving skills in real time. You will own a major part in researching and investigating new online-fraud trends and stand at the forefront of Riskified’s work. You’ll leverage your data analysis skills and knowledge of our product to provide meaningful insights directly to our customers.

  • Research and explore data, using high level analytical tools (R and SQL) in a high level technical environment
  • Master the online fraud prevention domain through hands-on analysis of live data
  • Define and execute end-to-end technical solutions for fraud-prevention problems
  • Share deep analysis conclusions and sophisticated technical methods in a clear manner to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Work with account managers, meet directly with clients, and deliver analytical insights to business questions
  • Collaborate with various teams within Riskified to enhance processes and meet customers’ needs

Qualifications

  • Fluent (written and verbal) in English and Portuguese required
  • 1-2+ years in fraud analytics
  • 1-2+ years of relevant strong analytical experience with complex data
  • 1-2+ years of hands-on work experience with SQL (must be proficient)
  • 1-2+ years of hands-on work experience with R / Python (must be proficient)
  • Experienced problem solver and critical thinker
  • Ability to work simultaneously on different tasks and lead multiple projects

*The position requires occasional evening and weekend shifts (schedule is flexible) as we support a global client base.

*Please submit your CV/Resume in English.

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Interview Day Belém | Transição de Carreira

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Interview Day : Dinâmica focada nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

  5. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  6. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  7. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  8. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

title: Intensief Ambulant Gezinsbehandelaar Mevis en Rotterdam
description:
Vind je het belangrijk dat ieder kind thuis moet kunnen opgroeien? En draag je daar graag aan bij als zorgprofessional? Wil jij werken bij een organisatie in opbouw? Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan het toekomstbestendig organiseren van ondersteuning en hulp aan jeugdigen en gezinnen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou. Is deze vacature op het lijf geschreven maar heb je niet de opleiding tot intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar gedaan, dan betalen we graag je opleiding IAG.

Het team van Mevis willen we versterken met een aantal Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaars.

Mevis is een coöperatie van vijf zorgorganisaties, dat in 2023 is opgezet: Timon, MEE Rotterdam-Rijnmond, Yulius, ASVZ en Prokino Zorg en de partner voor de jeugdhulp in de gemeenten Maassluis, Vlaardingen en Schiedam. Mevis biedt jeugdhulp door deze dicht bij het kind en gezin – en zoveel mogelijk in het dagelijkse leven – te organiseren.

Geduld, doorzettingsvermogen en stáán voor het kind

Kinderen zijn gewoonlijk het best af bij hun eigen ouders. Sommige thuissituaties zijn complex. Ouders en kind die elkaar niet begrijpen, bijvoorbeeld vanwege een diagnose. Het kind dat zich afzet. Ouders die niet consequent zijn of té streng zijn en weinig liefde geven. Of zelf een verleden hebben. Als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar ondersteun je ouders in de zorg voor en opvoeding van hun kind. Dat vraagt om geduld én doorzettingsvermogen. Om empathisch vermogen en om stáán voor het kind.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar ben je er vooral voor de ouders, in het belang van het kind. Je brengt de situatie in kaart en stelt samen doelen. Je voert gesprekken met de ouders, het kind en het hele gezin. Samen werk je ernaar toe dat ze weer samen verder kunnen: de ouders en het kind. Dat is niet altijd een soepel traject. Het vraagt dus wel iets van jou als Intensief ambulant gezinsbehandelaar. Het uiteindelijke doel? Een fijne en veilige opgroeisituatie voor het kind. Daarnaast werkt je bij Mevis in het multidisciplinaire plusteam waarbij je meedenkt aan beleid en visie en consulteert aan en actief meegaat met wijkteams naar gezinnen. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt ouders en kinderen in complexe thuis situaties.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je houdt zelfstandig gesprekken en bepaalt wat nodig is.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor ouders en biedt handvatten.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt.
  • Je houdt de veiligheid en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van het kind in de gaten.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper.
  • Je werkt samen met het plusteam van Mevis.

Het team waarin je komt te werken is een multidisciplinair team met collega's die elkaar opzoeken, elkaar helpen, ervoor zorgen dat ze van elkaar leren en lol hebben in hun werk. Je werkt zelfstandig maar kan altijd terugvallen op een leuk team van professionals.

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Ervaring in de jeugdhulpverlening.
  • Kennis van therapeutische principes en systeemgerichte interventies.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg schaal 9, vanaf € 3.042,75 tot € 4.544,51, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 750 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Binnen Timon zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren . Bijvoorbeeld binnen een van de zorgconcepten die we bieden. Zoals Ouderschap na Scheiding, Kinderen uit de Knel, intensieve ambulante gezinsbegeleiding (IAG) en Ambulante spoedhulp.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Dan zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet.

Wil je een dag meelopen om kennis te maken met het team en de werkzaamheden, dan is dat mogelijk. Heb je nog vragen of wil je liever eerst wat meer informatie? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze recruiter

title: XP Future | Transição de Carreira | São Paulo
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - São Paulo , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar presencialmente em São Paulo;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

*Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Software Engineering Team Leader Curitiba
description:
EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to connect global and regional companies to consumers in Latin America. With its own technology and infrastructure, combined with in-depth knowledge of the Latin American market, EBANX allows these companies to connect to hundreds of payment methods in different countries in the region. And it goes further, creating results for businesses and simple shopping experiences for consumers.

From the beginning of our journey, we have an important mission: to give access . And this is not just about our products and services, but it goes through everything we are and do. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

You will work in a team of experienced developers and be responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactional requests every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback, and meritocracy.

As an EBANX leader you will be responsible for:

  • Managing a highly qualified and technical team;
  • Contribute and collaborate with the product areas and the development engineering team;
  • Have fun doing the management of technical teams and enabling the delivery of relevant products with global impact;
  • Create and send weekly reports on the progress of the team's activities to stakeholders;
  • Doing thorough code-reviews and help your teammates with complex designs and architectural decisions;
  • Testing and following your code to production continuously;
  • Working on strategic projects for EBANX;
  • Evolving and deciding the future of our payments platform;
  • A system of high availability (+ 99.9%) and with high throughput (100+ TPS), written in PHP, and MySQL (yes, it is possible :smile:). Don't know PHP? No problems, the important thing is to master the basics!
  • Mentoring and developing new talents;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production;
  • Proven experience of at least 2 years leading a team of software engineers;
  • Interest in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;
  • Expertise in git or any other collaborative version control system;
  • A vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • A great ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Advanced English (read, write and speak);

What would we love to see?

  • Passion for software, you go to sleep and wake up thinking about how to make that part of the system more elegant or efficient;
  • Fluent English, we have customers from all around the world and it is commonplace for us to speak and write English when helping, supporting, and writing specifications with them;
  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS.
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Test-driven development: you don't even remember how to code without a very extensive test coverage; You often write the tests first and then the code.
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language -- besides SQL ;)
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;
  • Knowledge of data replication and conciliation;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • The best tools money can buy so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others)
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Frequent, fair, and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;
  • Casual office and flexible dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

title: Engineering Manager, Payments
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You're an original. So are we.

We're a company of people who like to forge our own path. We invented the blue jean in 1873, and we reinvented khaki pants in 1986. We pioneered labor and environmental guidelines in manufacturing. And we work to build sustainability into everything we do. Our brands stand for freedom and self-expression around the world.

Where we lead, others follow. For more than 160 years, we've used the strength of our brands to lead with our values and make an outsized impact on the world. We employ more than 15,000 people globally to support our great brands: Levi's, Dockers, Denizen, Signature by Levi Strauss & Co. and Beyond Yoga.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead the Payments domain in our technology organization. This role is critical to ensuring secure, scalable, and efficient payment processing across our global e-commerce and retail ecosystem. You will be responsible for managing a high-performing engineering team that builds and operates payment APIs and services supporting credit cards, gift cards, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), fraud detection, reconciliation, and in-store payment integrations.

You will drive technical excellence, architecture, and execution in alignment with our domain-driven design and direct-to-consumer strategy. As an engineering leader, you will collaborate with product management, security, store teams, mobile app team, website teams, and external payment providers to deliver robust, compliant, and scalable payment solutions . You will lead a highly skilled team of software engineers in a “you build it, you run it” environment. Your primary responsibility will be to drive your team toward successful and efficient delivery of high-quality software, while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You’ll ensure the team is aligned with company goals, adheres to best engineering practices, and upholds robust DevOps principles, including designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the applications and services they create.

About the Job

  • Lead and Mentor : Provide technical guidance, career development support, and mentorship to team members, helping them to grow in both technical and soft skills.

  • Team Leadership & Culture : Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and trust where engineers feel ownership of their work and are empowered to take initiative.

  • Strategic Planning : Work closely with Product Management, UX, and other stakeholders to define and deliver on a roadmap aligned with company objectives and customer needs.

  • Technical Execution : Ensure that technical designs, code, and testing meet high standards. Facilitate architectural and design discussions to guarantee scalable and resilient solutions.

  • Process Management : Improve software development processes, implementing best practices for CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing, and deployment to streamline development and deployment cycles.

  • Ownership of Operations : Champion a DevOps mindset, where the team not only builds but also runs and monitors their own applications in production, ensuring reliability, availability, and performance.

  • Problem Solving : Facilitate solutions to complex technical problems, proactively identifying bottlenecks, risks, and quality concerns, and implementing measures to address them.

  • Performance Monitoring : Track and report on team performance, KPIs, and quality metrics, ensuring a high level of transparency and focus on improvement areas. Prioritize talent development and help with hiring new talent and grow engineers that are already at Levi Strauss & Co.

  • Experience Working with Global Companies: Work with teams around the world and support your global-capable platform.

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in product and/or platform engineering role, with tangible accomplishments in ecommerce or similar customer-facing digital experiences and APIs.

  • Proven Experience : Minimum 7 years of engineering experience, including hands-on software development and at least 2 years in a management or technical leadership role.

  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in any of Java, Node.js, TypeScript, GoLang, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering and DevOps practices. Deep knowledge of RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native services.

  • Strong Leadership : Track record of managing and motivating a team, fostering a productive, collaborative, and high-accountability environment.

  • Process Improvement : Demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements that accelerate development without compromising quality.

  • Problem Solving & Decision Making : Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions and prioritize effectively.

  • Stakeholder Management : Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially Product and UX, to ensure cohesive product development and delivery.

  • Operational Excellence : Commitment to maintaining high standards for operational reliability, availability, and scalability, as well as familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Hands-on experience with payment gateways, acquiring banks, fraud prevention, and reconciliation .

  • Understanding of PCI compliance, security best practices, and fraud prevention strategies.

  • Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, chargebacks, and settlement processes.

LOCATION : Mexico, D.F., Mexico

FULL TIME/PART TIME : Full time

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and promotes affirmative actions as an employer.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: São Paulo, State of São Paulo, Brazil; Belo Horizonte, State of Minas Gerais, Brazil .

Preferred Qualifications:

About the Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design, and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities, and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications, and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software.
  • Research, conceive, and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.
  • Collaborate on scalability issues involving access to data and information.
  • Manage individual and team priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to building a workforce that is representative of the users we serve, creating a culture of belonging, and providing equal employment opportunity regardless of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), expecting or parents-to-be, criminal histories consistent with legal requirements, or any other basis protected by law.

About This Role

The Director, LATAM Country and Site Operations (CSO) provides leadership and operational oversight for Country and Site Operations in Latin America, including Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru. The position oversees a high-performing regional Country and Site Operations team, comprising Country Clinical Sciences Leads (CCSLs), Clinical Research Monitors (CRAs), and Clinical Monitoring Leads (CMLs), which includes both Full-Time Employees (FTEs) and Functional Service Providers (FSPs). The CSO develops and implements region-specific strategies to optimize trial delivery and operational performance while ensuring compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and local regulatory requirements.

This role strengthens Biogen’s presence in Latin America by building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, investigators, site staff, regulatory bodies, and patient organizations. The Director CSO also acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), representing the Country and Site Operations function during the development and execution of global initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Operational Leadership

  • Provide operational leadership and oversight of Country and Site Operations across the LATAM region.

  • Develop and implement specific operational strategies to optimize clinical trial delivery, operational performance, and resource allocation across Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru.

  • Deliver proactive operational intelligence on regional regulatory and clinical trial

  • environments to guide country and site selection strategies and enhance trial planning.

Operational Management

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of clinical trials in the LATAM region, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

  • Ensure compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, Standard

  • Operating Procedures (SOPs), and local and international regulations governing clinical trial conduct.

  • Monitor quality metrics, operational performance, and trial progress, implementing corrective actions when necessary to maintain excellence.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing regional Country and Site Operations team, including CCSLs, Clinical Project Managers, Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), CRMs, and CMLs (both FTEs and FSPs).

  • Assist in recruiting new staff and ensure staff retention and turnover rates remain within expected levels.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and professional growth among team members.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, investigators, site staff, regulatory bodies, and patient organizations, to strengthen Biogen’s presence in Latin America.

  • Represent Biogen at local industry, scientific, and patient organization meetings, advocating for the company’s clinical programs and fostering external partnerships.

  • Facilitate effective engagement with Key Medical Experts (KMEs) in collaboration with affiliate personnel to ensure alignment with clinical and business strategies.

Global Alignment and SME Representation

  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), representing Country and Site Operations in the review and execution of global initiatives.

  • Provide global teams with detailed regional operational and scientific knowledge from engagements.

  • Ensure thoughtful integration of local opportunities and needs into global strategies.

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a deep understanding of clinical operations and trial delivery. You thrive in dynamic environments and have excellent interpersonal skills that allow you to build strong relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders. Your ability to mentor and develop teams fosters collaboration and accountability, driving operational excellence. You are passionate about making a meaningful impact on the company's presence in Latin America and are adept at representing the organization on a global stage.

Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; advanced/graduate degree preferred.

  • 12+ years’ experience in clinical development, experience across multiple clinical operations disciplines including field-based site-facing clinical operations roles, clinical trial delivery via an outsourcing model.

  • Deep understanding of the LATAM Clinical Trial environment.

  • Ability to collaborate cross functionally.

  • Experienced people manager.

  • Strong understanding of regulatory environment regarding GCP, clinical trial regulations and regulatory guidances pertinent to clinical trial conduct in assigned region.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including experience working with various levels of senior management.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • R&D project leadership experience preferred.

  • Fluency in Spanish.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding-edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.
This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
What we are looking for in you
  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
