Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Dev Ops Engineer. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

  1. Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  2. Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  3. Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

The IT DevOps Engineer - Cloud Engineering role has knowledge of and performs both development and operational tasks to maintain application assets. This role works with developers, architects, and app teams facilitating operations, development, and testing functions by continuously automating and streamlining the system integration and deployment processes. If you're not afraid to challenge the status quo and make your mark, this role is for you!

Essential Functions

  • Coding, deploying, and supporting large scale, serverless architectures.
  • Designing and developing enhancements to applications when identified by the creation of new components.
  • Designing and developing automation when the opportunity arises.
  • Designing and building DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preparing and presenting system documentation and analysis as well as writing SQL queries to troubleshoot application problems.
  • Building, deploying, and maintaining source code of new versions of applications in the cloud hosting environment.
  • Performing Systems Administrator duties such as SSH into individual servers to review logs and triage problems, leveraging monitoring solutions such as Splunk, New Relic, or other monitoring tools.
  • Setting up resources such as load-balancers and compute instances.
  • Implementing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).
  • Preparing and presenting technical presentations and system process documentation.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with services such as Compute, Storage, and API Management.
  • Full stack development experience with technologies such as React, Redux, and NodeJS server-side development using ES2015.
  • Knowledge of designing and building fully automated DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using automation servers like Jenkins, GoCD, TravisCI, etc.
  • Ability to define Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipelines using JSON or YAML and understand designing incremental promotion across environments.
  • Strong understanding of Python/Go and Bash/PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience writing scripts to automate mundane tasks.
  • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix and Windows.
  • Database awareness: NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB), Relational (Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Experience in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) concepts and implementation with Terraform.
  • Experience implementing Policy-as-Code and event-driven security in cloud environments.
  • A working understanding of enterprise networking concepts like CIDR.
  • Code, deploy, and support large scale enterprise-grade architecture.
  • Experience designing, configuring, and deploying applications.
  • Understanding of complex applications, micro-services, and serverless use cases.
  • Experience with Kubernetes.
  • Excited about trying new solutions.
  • Embraces a culture of trust and complete transparency.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology related areas.
  • Technical certificates are a plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in complex cloud solutions environments.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

Bunge, a global leader in agribusiness, has an exciting opportunity available for a Director, Operational Technology Security. The hybrid work environment provides a balance between in-office and remote work.

Overview
The Director, Operational Technology Security prioritizes the stability, efficiency, and security of Bunge's operational technology (OT) infrastructure. Responsibilities include managing a team of OT professionals, overseeing OT systems and processes, and collaborating with various stakeholders to ensure alignment with business and security objectives. Make decisions aligned to Bunge’s global strategy, business needs and financial goals and explore new perspectives by driving innovation. Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of OT security best practices and relevant industry standards (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443).
  • Experience with OT network design, implementation, and management.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

title: Monster Ambassador Team (MAT)
description:
Resumo da Vaga
O Monster Ambassador Team é um programa de marketing global da Monster Energy Company. O objetivo do programa é:

  1. Gerar experimentação/degustação de produtos Monster Energy Drink pelos consumidores.
  2. Comunicar a mensagem/pilares da Marca MEC (Monster Energy Company) estrategicamente aos consumidores. Exemplo de atuação: Esportes de ação, Automobilismo, Música e Gaming.
  3. Auxiliar na geração de leads para a divisão de vendas.
  4. Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com key accounts.
  5. Construir redes de influência na região.
  6. Apoiar os esforços de vendas por meio de sampling em eventos e merchandising (caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader).

Funções essenciais da vaga:

Os embaixadores terão várias funções e responsabilidades relacionadas ao engajamento do consumidor e merchandising, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao seguinte:

  1. Gerar ativamente a degustação de Monster Energy durante o sampling de guerrilha.
  2. Abordar consumidores que “precisam” de energia e fazer a degustação.
  3. Distribuir brindes aos consumidores para reforçar a fidelidade à marca.
  4. Executar eventos, de todos os níveis, incluindo os eventos de Base, para esportes e cultura com foco na experiência da marca. Se necessário, coordenar ativações com agências e parceiros.
  5. Desenvolver redes pessoais de relacionamentos internos e externos eficazes, incluindo Equipes de Engarrafadores do Sistema KO.
  6. Cooperar com outros membros da equipe.
  7. Acompanhar as atividades dos concorrentes da marca em campo e relatar em tempo hábil.
  8. Responsabilizar-se pelo bom uso dos materiais e recursos do programa da empresa Monster Energy.
  9. Ser pontual e cumprir o turno agendado pelo supervisor direto.
  10. Manter a aparência da marca usando uniforme adequado, mantendo hábitos de higiene de imagem pessoal conforme sugerido no manual de treinamento.
  11. Garantir profissionalismo, comunicação excepcional e interações proativas com consumidores e colegas de trabalho.
  12. Responder em tempo hábil ao MAT Leader e ao Regional MAT Manager.
  13. Pode ser necessário viajar - Caso requisitado.

Merchandising (Caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader)
• Promover produtos MEC em geladeiras e em coolers.
• Conforme designado, realizar verificações de rotina nas lojas para garantir que as gôndolas estejam abastecidas com os produtos MEC de acordo com as sugestões do MAT Leader e TDM.
• Verificar se todos os Pontos de Venda (PDV) estão positivados corretamente e com precisão ao nível da loja, incluindo; mas não limitado a preços, sinalização promocional e displays.
• Transmitir dados obtidos no mercado com MAT Leader e TDM.
• Gerenciar com responsabilidade todos os materiais e ativos do programa da Monster Energy Co.
Deve relatar quaisquer questões relacionados aos funcionários do PDV ao MAT Leader alinhado com o TDM.

Requisitos da Vaga:
• Deve ter 21 anos ou mais.
• Deve ter um registro de condução limpo.
• Deve ser capaz de levantar até 19 kg, estar fisicamente apto e ativo.
• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé por longos períodos de tempo.
• Ter um alto nível de energia com uma atitude de “consigo fazer”.
• Preocupar-se com a imagem pessoal e higiene.
• Ser socialmente responsável, extrovertido e prezar pela diversidade.
• Ter interesse em esportes de ação é um extra.
• Experiência promocional é um extra.
• Domínio fluente de inglês, espanhol ou outros idiomas é um extra.

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Sales Digitalization and Salesforce Analyst to lead the sales systems transformation project in Brazil, including post-implementation sales systems management. The Analyst will drive seamless collaboration with local teams in São Paulo while maintaining effective communication with global counterparts. This role also includes aligning project deliverables with global IT standards and ensuring a successful Salesforce Suite implementation. In addition, job responsibility includes support for local implementation for Brazil of the e-commerce solution as well as other customer-oriented applications.

Project Leadership:

  1. Oversee the end-to-end management of the Salesforce implementation project in Brazil, ensuring timely delivery of milestones while adhering to scope, budget, and quality standards.

  4. Ensure user adoption of Salesforce solutions.

Technical Oversight:

  1. Partner with technical experts to customize and integrate Salesforce solutions.

Ongoing Responsibilities:

  1. Manage the CRM system in Brazil post-implementation, ensuring it remains aligned with global standards and business needs.

Technical Skills:

Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

title: Principal Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Principal Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As Principal Concept Artist you will work with the development teams to create memorable environments along with unique and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in both character and environment design will provide the inspiration which will continue to push the boundaries of what Fornite means to our players.

In this role, you will
  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize many different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of Concept Artists and outsourcing vendors
  • Provide timely & detailed feedback for the concept art team and outsourcing vendors
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product
What we're looking for
  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Lead or Principal Concept Artist role
  • Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • 7 + years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

description:
Position Summary/Resumo da Posição

In the position of Business Developer you will be achieving long-term strategic and tactical sales and distribution plan for the Monster brand portfolio in support of the company's business objectives. Manage distributor/bottler business results in the Coca Cola Operating Unit assigned region/district and be responsible for the success of the compnay in that respective territory. Accomplished through effective distributor management skills, solid fieldwork skills (negotiation, visits and market execution) and the ability to develop strong relationships.

Na posição de Desenvolvedor Comercial, você alcançará um plano estratégico e tático de vendas e distribuição de longo prazo para o portfólio da marca Monster em apoio aos objetivos de negócios da empresa. Gerenciará os resultados de negócios do distribuidor/engarrafador na região/distrito atribuído à Unidade Operacional da Coca Cola e será responsável pelo sucesso da empresa naquele respectivo território. Realizado por meio de habilidades eficazes de gerenciamento de distribuidores, sólidas habilidades de trabalho de campo (negociação, visitas e execução de mercado) e a capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos fortes.

Essential Job Functions/Funções Essenciais do Trabalho

  • Manage relationships with the distributors and some customers in the assigned territory. Responsible for market execution in the territory in Traditional Trade and Modern Trade.
  • Gerenciar relacionamentos com os distribuidores e alguns clientes no território designado. Responsável pela execução de mercado no território em Traditional Trade e Modern Trade.
  • Maximize the sale and distribution of all company products in the assigned region through the establishment and appropriate execution of local and national sales programs.
  • Maximizar a venda e distribuição de todos os produtos da empresa na região designada por meio do estabelecimento e execução adequada de programas de vendas locais e nacionais.
  • Train and coach the distributor/ bottlers sales force to engage them with the Monster brand and objectives.
  • Treinar e orientar a força de vendas dos distribuidores/engarrafadores para envolvê-los com a marca e os objetivos da Monster.
  • Ensure the execution of national and regional account strategies for all company products and achieve sales, profit and market share objectives for all national and regional accounts and/or programs.
  • Garantir a execução de estratégias de contas nacionais e regionais para todos os produtos da empresa e atingir objetivos de vendas, lucro e participação de mercado para todas as contas e/ou programas nacionais e regionais.
  • Monitor market/retailer activity to develop the most cost-effective strategies in order to drive volume and profitability through increased penetration and promotion.
  • Monitore a atividade do mercado/varejista para desenvolver as estratégias mais econômicas para impulsionar o volume e a lucratividade por meio do aumento da penetração e da promoção.
  • Develop, manage and/or maximize partnerships to drive improved performance. Develop and use objective tools, information and feedback in order to establish region and area performance goals and results.
  • Desenvolver, gerenciar e/ou maximizar parcerias para impulsionar desempenho aprimorado. Desenvolver e usar ferramentas objetivas, informações e feedback para estabelecer metas e resultados de desempenho de região e área.
  • Conduct business performance reviews with distributors/Bottlers in order to track, monitor and adjust efforts and produce desired outcomes in all key business segments.
  • Realizar avaliações de desempenho empresarial com distribuidores/engarrafadores para rastrear, monitorar e ajustar esforços e produzir os resultados desejados em todos os principais segmentos de negócios.
  • Work closely with National Sales and Regional Account Management Teams to understand and communicate customer programs and activities that impact their respective market.
  • Trabalhe em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas nacionais e de gerenciamento de contas regionais para entender e comunicar programas e atividades dos clientes que impactam seus respectivos mercados.

Position Requirements/Requisitos da posição

  • Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of -- Business Administration or related field.
  • Prefirível um diploma de bacharel em administração de empresas ou área relacionada.
  • Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in sales.

  • Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in retail, wholesaler or distributor sales environment.

About the Role:

The Team:

Our Electric Power team is seeking a Price Reporter based in Mexico-City responsible for publishing and developing key Platts benchmark assessments for the North American power market. This position will play a crucial role in supporting the team to maintain and enhance our market leadership and the integrity of our pricing assessments.

Responsibilities and Impact:

Key Responsibilities:

U.S. Southeast Power Market Focus:

  • Serve as the primary analyst for the U.S. Southeast Power Market, delivering timely and accurate pricing assessments.
  • Collaborate with the Houston-based team to ensure seamless market coverage and information flow.

Support for Other U.S. Power Markets:

  • Provide coverage for additional U.S. power markets as required, supporting the Houston-based market coverage rota.
  • Assist in the analysis and reporting of market trends and developments across various regions.

Battery Storage Assessments:

  • Manage and analyse battery storage assessments, providing insights and commentary to enhance our understanding of this evolving sector.
  • Develop reports that highlight trends, opportunities, and challenges within the battery storage market.

Market Research in Mexico:

  • Conduct comprehensive market research to explore potential coverage of the Mexican power market.
  • Identify key players, regulatory changes, and market opportunities that could impact our assessments and strategies.

Natural Gas Initiative Support:

  • Assist in the natural gas initiative within the Mexican market, contributing to the development of strategies and assessments that align with market needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a holistic approach to market analysis.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Economics, Finance, Environmental Science).

title: Especialista de Qualidade de Dados (Specialist IV)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring:

Na TransUnion, temos um ambiente acolhedor e enérgico que incentiva a colaboração e a inovação - estamos constantemente explorando novas tecnologias e ferramentas para sermos ágeis. Este ambiente dá ao nosso pessoal a oportunidade de aprimorar as habilidades atuais e construir novas capacidades, descobrindo seus talentos.

Somos uma empresa de oportunidades iguais e todas as pessoas qualificadas para nossas vagas serão consideradas em nossos processos seletivos independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, idade, status de pessoa com deficiência (PcD), orientação sexual, identidade de gênero ou demais recortes sociais relacionados a grupos sub representados. Estamos trabalhando para trazer maior representatividade social para a nossa empresa, garantindo que as pessoas se sintam parte de nossas equipes e dando apoio para que conquistem cargos de liderança. Reconhecemos que ainda há trabalho a ser feito e não vamos parar até que todas as pessoas que passem pelas nossas portas diariamente se sintam incluídas. Venha fazer parte da nossa história!

What You'll Bring:

  • Experiência com manipulação de dados: Business Intelligence, Data Quality, Data Governance, Ciência de Dados, Análise de Dados.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em Governança de Dados utilizando frameworks atuais (DAMA, CMMi DMM ou DCAM).
  • Capacidade prática de analisar grandes quantidades de dados, reconhecer padrões e tendências e organizar observações em um formato claro e útil.
  • Conhecimento em MS Excel e bancos de dados (SQL, ETL, Hive, Linguagem R).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Tableau (preferencial) e Power BI.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Capacidade de liderar e gerenciar projetos individuais e junto ao time.
  • Conhecimento em automatização de processos (Integration Services - diferencial).

Impact You'll Make:

Será responsável pelos processos técnicos, definições de dados e regras de dados que criam, governam e informam os dados usados nos produtos e serviços da TransUnion.

  • Liderar projetos de governança de dados com atuação cross nas diversas áreas de dados.
  • Coletar, analisar e sintetizar as informações de uma variedade de conjuntos de dados grandes e/ou complexos para entender o comportamento dos dados de pessoas consumidoras.
  • Desenvolver painéis e relatórios para fornecer insights sobre qualidade de dados e métricas de desempenho para clientes da TransUnion e partes interessadas internas, incluindo operações de dados e grupos de operações de pessoas consumidoras.
  • Resolver desafios complexos relacionados a painéis de qualidade de dados usando análises descritivas e preditivas.
  • Realizar análises de dados ad-hoc para responder a perguntas de negócios e orientar a estratégia.
  • Entendimento de medições de qualidade de dados, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Auxiliar com estimativas de planos e cronogramas de projetos de qualidade de dados.
  • Manter contato com a equipe Global da TransUnion para adequação de processos e uso de ferramentas globais.
  • Monitorar os dashboards e processo de qualidade de dados, endereçando as ações de melhoria junto ao time de soluções.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

TransUnion Job Title

Specialist IV, Batch Processing

title: Market Development Specialist
description:
Overview

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with an industry leader in audio technology? We're seeking a dynamic and passionate Market Development Specialist to drive business growth by generating demands and opportunities in the vibrant Pro Audio market segment in Brazil.

This position is based in São Paulo - SP.

Responsibilities
  • Implements strategic plans to seed and go-to-market with new products and technologies
  • Identifies, researches, evaluates and prioritizes market leads and opportunities to influence purchases and specifications with key end-users and influencers
  • Identifies needs for education programs and helps to develop and deliver presentations to increase awareness and understanding of the benefits of Shure’s product categories
  • Executes educational programs, presentations, conferences, seminars, clinics and other events with Sales Management to increase awareness and understanding of the benefits of Company products
  • Assists independent channel partners in identifying and closing leads and opportunities
  • Identifies and forms relationships with potential customers outside of the current Company revenue stream
  • Creates new revenue opportunities by matching customers, applications and products
  • Monitors and reports on competitive activity, both from a product and market development standpoint
  • Monitors online forums as assigned and reports on items of interest to the Company
  • Performs other duties as assigned
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pro audio market with a comprehensive technical knowledge of audio principles and equipment and continues developing professional expertise
  • Background or experience with broadcasting and music industry
  • Has a full understanding of industry practices and/or company policies and procedures
  • Experience providing audio technical support, audio design and audio equipment set-up
  • Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions for difficult assignments and of diverse scope
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Enjoys meeting and dealing with new people
  • Knowledge of audio DSP technology
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management (i.e. Salesforce)
  • Proficient troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to learn new technologies
  • Ability to handle multiple assignments work independently and see projects through to successful completion
  • Detail oriented, well-organized, and good time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Language skills: Fluent Portuguese. English highly desired. Spanish a plus

WHO WE ARE

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for nearly a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

THE MIX MATTERS

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

Transportando pessoas, materiais e equipamentos, próprios e/ou de clientes, operando guincho, requisitando, recebendo e conferindo materiais e equipamentos e emitindo relatórios, visando ao pleno atendimento das necessidades do cliente em conformidade com normas e procedimentos técnicos e de segurança adotados pela Empresa.

Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!

description:
About CDP:

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

About the Team:

CDP’s Sales function is responsible for generating sales of CDP products to new customers, as well as renewing existing customers and identifying greenfield opportunities within the existing book of business. The Sales function is market and customer oriented and establishes go-to market strategies that serve key personas across financial corporates, non-financial corporates, and distributors and channels. The Sales function works closely with M&C and Customer Success to deliver a smooth customer experience.

Key relationship management function in market, overseeing the renewals book of business and identifying greenfield opportunities to expand relationships with existing customers.

About this role:

As a CDP Market Director, you will have dual responsibilities: serving as the Sub-Regional Market Head and leading the Relationship Management function. In your role as Sub-Regional Head, you will be the senior market-facing representative, engaging with customers at the most senior level and representing CDP at events. Additionally, you will operate within a matrixed organizational structure, providing leadership and guidance to the team. Leading the relationship management function, you will oversee renewals, responsible for the custody and cultivation of the existing book of business.

What you will do:

Manage an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

  • Working with the Talent Attraction team to identify and recruit the right talent to the team
  • Providing focus and direction, through regular 1:1’s, setting clear objectives, providing ongoing, honest feedback, recognition, structured performance and development conversations, and helping with solutions
  • Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members can communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference. Help resolve conflict as appropriate
  • Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to their position

Strategic Growth Planning:

  • Collaborate with the CRO to develop a comprehensive strategic growth plan focused on revenue-generating activities for the region. This plan should align with the overall business objectives and drive sustainable growth

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Foster seamless collaboration among Sales team members (business development and relationship managers), Customer Success teams (under CDO), and Marketing & Communications (under CMO) to ensure an exceptional client experience. This includes facilitating effective communication and coordination across departments.

Net Renewal Rate (NRR) Achievement:

  • Achieve the sub-regional Net Renewal Rate (NRR) budget by providing tactical advice and support to Relationship Management teams. This involves analyzing performance metrics and implementing strategies to improve client retention.

Go-to-Market (GTM) Execution:

  • Execute go-tomarket (GTM) initiatives effectively, ensuring that all activities are aligned with the strategic growth plan and market demands.

External Representation:

  • Represent CDP at key external events, including speaking engagements at conferences. This role requires strong public speaking skills and the ability to articulate CDP's value proposition to diverse audiences.

Market and Competitive Analysis:

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the competitive landscape, market trends, and client feedback. This includes conducting regular market research and using insights to inform strategic decisions.

Leadership Participation:

  • Actively participate in and contribute to CDP leadership groups. This involves collaborating with senior leaders to shape the organization's strategic direction.

Global System Integration:

  • Ensure CDP's role within the global system by providing local context and aiding in the development of global organizational strategies. This includes sharing regional insights and best practices with global counterparts

Fundraising and Development Support:

  • Support local fundraising and development efforts in alignment with global priorities and strategies. This involves identifying potential funding opportunities and building relationships with key stakeholders.

Regional Strategy Development:

  • Collaborate with other country and regional offices to develop regional strategies and share best practices. This includes fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Behavioural Traits and Values:

  • Embody and promote CDP's core values of moving together, finding solutions, transparency and optimism. These values should guide all interactions and decision-making processes, ensuring a positive and forward-thinking organizational culture.

The types of roles managed might include relationship managers for financial and nonfinancial corporates.

Internal stakeholders include: disclosure request, disclosure, signatory and data delivery, rev ops, M&C, business development colleagues, impact/TL, policy.

External stakeholders include: corporate and nonfinancial corporates.

This role is a budget holder for renewal of corporate and non-financial corporates.

We're looking for:

  • Extensive and proven experience working in commercial organizations in leadership of sales and account management.
  • Proven track record of developing strong strategic client/stakeholder relationships with financial and non-financial corporates.
  • A strong network of contacts you can use to advance the deep and longstanding relationships CDP holds.
  • Proven track record of creating and implementing strategies to deliver on business and/or impact targets.
  • Background in and knowledge of local business, policy, and sustainability culture, with a known reputation in this sector.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Relevant degree qualification or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent in at least one local language

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

// Sobre a oportunidade

Este é um banco de talentos direcionado para pessoas que buscam oportunidades nas mais diversas áreas da XP Inc. Temos:

  • Dois programas de estágio (e algumas vagas pontuais desta natureza entre as janelas dessas oportunidades);
  • Programas de formação e aceleração para um público recém formado ou próximo de concluir a graduação;
  • Programas de transição de carreira, para quem já tem experiência em outro setor e deseja migrar para o mercado financeiro;
  • Vagas efetivas.

Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato te chamando para o processo seletivo em questão.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios . Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Desafios que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Ambiente dinâmico e aberto para novas ideias;
  • Liberdade para trilhar uma carreira protagonista;
  • Espaço para desenvolvimento e aprendizado constantes.

// Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Nossa cultura de mente aberta torna o ambiente horizontal para que as decisões sejam tomadas com base em fatos e dados, colocando os interesses dos clientes sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Com espírito empreendedor, cada um de nós protagoniza a sua própria história , então não espere encontrar uma empresa que tome decisões por você.
  • Apesar de todos terem autonomia para assumir as rédeas da própria vida, a nossa rotina é intensa por sonharmos grande e amarmos o que fazemos.

// O perfil que estamos buscando e os pré-requisitos para a sua candidatura:

  • Ter nossa cultura;
  • Paixão pelo mercado financeiro;
  • Alto raciocínio lógico;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo presencial/híbrido (de três a cinco vezes por semana no escritório) em São Paulo;
  • Não atuar como agente autônomo de investimentos em algum escritório da rede afiliada à XP.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. The Customer Onboarding Manager is the key member of the Onboarding team. Using a combination of hands-on approach with strong project management principles and technical knowledge, the Customer Onboarding Manager will be responsible for providingtechnical guidance to the client. title: Senior Biodiversity Expert
description:
ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;

  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.

  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.

  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.

  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.

  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.

ABOUT ERM:

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

title: Senior Biodiversity Expert
description:
ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;

  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.

  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.

  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.

  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.

  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.

ABOUT ERM:

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

(DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

Project management activities include project planning and tracking, budget planning and tracking, resource management, issue management, risk management, status reporting etc. The Delivery Manager will manage the daily task completion of a cross-functional project team comprising, customer, o9 and partners. The Delivery Manager will also act as the primary interface with the client regarding deliverables, change requests, and sign-offs.

What you’ll do for us…

Participate in the complete lifecycle of projects from blueprint to hypercare

Create a detailed project plan and align all stakeholders on the jointly developed project plan, milestones, and timelines

Track plan vs. actuals and document the reasons for any deviations. Develop action plan to mitigate any delays

Provide detailed project status to all stakeholders on the agreed upon cadence

Document vacation schedules for all team members

Approve all timesheets and invoices in a timely manner

Complete any project management and administration tasks required by the client

Ensure each team members knows the tasks and deliverables they have to work on

Document any risks and work with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans

Maintain a detailed issue log with appropriate ETA, ownership and resolution

Provide necessary knowledge transition and documentation to o9 support team post go-live

Continually engage with the customers to manage priorities and expectations

Ensure timely communication with regards to any project or personnel concerns

What you’ll have…

Education:

Bachelor's or Master degree

Experience:

6-10 years of experience implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics domain with a focus on planning

Project Management experience through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, and deployment

Experience using agile methodology to deliver enterprise implementations

Skills:

Knowledge of supply chain solutions

PMP certification is a plus

Strong knowledge of project management principles and artifacts is a must

Knowledge of project management software (Microsoft Project, JIRA etc.), spreadsheet (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required

Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration are required

Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones

What we’ll do for you…

Competitive salary and benefits.

Stock options to eligible candidates

High growth organization - very strong entrepreneurial culture and no corporate politics

Support network: Work with a team you can learn from and every day

Diversity: We pride ourselves on our international working environment

Social: Fun after-work activities like Friday Socials. If you’re in the office, feel free to join these events in person.

Food and drink: Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas and coffees on us.

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMER - UNREAL ENGINE What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

Epic Games is looking for a Pipeline Developer to join the Special Projects team to help us improve efficiency and build scalable creative production tool sets around UE. This role will have a particular focus on building out Machine Learning, AI, and Cloud-Based workflows and infrastructure to support emerging creative experiences. This is an exciting moment for technology and for creators, and the role offers the opportunity to participate in the building of vital systems that bind the engine with cloud and AI. We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about supporting teams and developing tools and workflows across one or more disciplines, are excited about emerging technology, and designing systems to help that technology be harnessed by creators. They should be able to communicate with various departments and teams to ensure that any pipeline we build is done so in close collaboration with the many other talented teams at Epic Games across the organization. Candidates should have a strong understanding of production needs and artist workflows - this role requires a clear understanding of how technology can be used to craft creative experiences, and successful candidates should have a passion for building tools for creators.

  • Build best-in-class production workflow tooling and automation
  • Scope out and drive production programming initiatives, working closely with other developers and stakeholders toward scalable, maintainable solutions
  • Deliver practical, forward-thinking solutions that address the needs of the team while working with production to balance development priorities and timelines

What we're looking for
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science/Programming, or relevant industry experience, with a strong foundation in software design patterns and object-oriented programming
  • 5+ years experience as a Pipeline Developer, Technical Artist, or similar, working on production in games, feature animation, VFX, or related industry

  • Bonus for experience in one or more of the following areas: Unreal Engine, C++, USD & OpenSource/Standards, ShotGrid/Flow Toolkit, Asset Management, Virtual Production
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

You will head a high-performing team of Business Development (BD) hunters and Sales Developement Representatives (SDR), responsible for identifying, negotiating, and closing partnerships with some of the most prominent enterprise and mid-market merchants in the region.
What you'll do:

  • Lead and inspire a team of commission-based Business Development Managers and SDRs focused on acquiring new Mid Market merchants in Americas.

  • Highly collaborative and effective at influencing internal stakeholders across the organization to accelerate deals and strategy.
What you bring:

We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking LAR (Latin America Region) Senior Legal Manager. This is a hybrid role that blends strategic legal business partnering (including M&A) with legal operations, driving innovation, data-led decisions, and scalable legal processes. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership while designing and implementing legal strategies that align with both local needs and global standards.
Your Responsibilities Will Include
Legal General

  • Provide strategic legal advice and support on a broad range of corporate, commercial, regulatory, and compliance matters.

¡Trabaja en Edelman Argentina!
En Edelman nos guiamos por nuestros valores en todo lo que hacemos: la búsqueda incansable de la excelencia, la libertad para ser siempre curiosos, el coraje para hacer lo correcto y el compromiso de impactar positivamente en la sociedad.

As pessoas que se cadastrarem nessa vaga terão seu perfil avaliado e armazenado em nosso banco de dados. A Nissan contrata com base no preenchimento do perfil do cargo na vaga, sem distinção ou discriminação baseada em gênero, identidade de gênero e/ou expressão, orientação sexual, raça, cor, idioma, religião, opinião política ou qualquer outra opinião, origem nacional ou social, posição econômica, nascimento ou qualquer outra condição. Operacional

title: CEO Newsletter: Summer 2024
description:
The summer season has brought some wonderful memories for our staff that included food, fun and festivities. Through our “Chat and Chew” committee, we helped to bring food and ice cream trucks for the enjoyment of our staff. Our Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Committee organized an international food festival in the main campus café which was a huge success. Thank you to all of our staff who helped to organize these events for sustaining the Jawonio culture of caring and joy.

The Summer Education Program is a time we look forward to all year. Hearing the laughter and seeing the connection between staff and our students each day is a constant reminder that so much good happens here. Over the years, thousands of children have had unforgettable experiences including making life-long friends, learning new skills, keeping up with their academics and therapies, and most importantly, having fun!!

While the program name transitioned from “Camp Jawonio” in the 1940’s to the Summer Education Program in recent decades, what hasn’t changed is the passion and commitment of staff who join us for these magical six weeks. Earlier this month, I had the opportunity to meet two former counselors, Ken Smith and Bob Smith who worked at Jawonio in 1966 and 1967. They shared their memories and during their visit, sang the original Camp Jawonio song. With tears in their eyes, they remembered every single word – even though they had not sung it for 57 years! Their memories of Jawonio have stayed with them since their first summer. Ken shared, during his visit, that Jawonio impacted his entire career. He told us that during his new manager meetings as a C-Suite Executive at Hilton International, he instilled the importance of volunteerism and charitable engagement as part of their work. He said that his leadership during his entire professional career was always influenced by Jawonio. This unforgettable visit truly shows the lifelong impact Jawonio has on the lives of our past, present, and future staff. It is but one amazing example of the “miracle of Jawonio” and makes me so proud to be part of Jawonio every day.

I want to take a moment to thank our 2024 Summer Education Program staff. To our educators, clinicians, one-to-one staff, nurses, music therapists and art teachers, thank you for keeping our students safe, healthy and happy as you inspired them to learn through play, music, art and swim over the past 6 weeks. Thank you to our parents and families who gave entrusted us with your beautiful children and teens. I also want to express my gratitude to our maintenance department and Jawonio Cleaning Company for ensuring a healthy and safe environment for our children.

Our ability to inspire our children and adults to reach their highest potential depends on the generosity and ongoing support of our Jawonio community. How can you help? You can sign up to become a monthly sustainer below or visit ourwebsite to find out the many ways you can make a difference!

Finally, please know that my door is always open and I would love to hear from you! You can also stay connected to us through social media. Follow us on Facebook, Instagram and subscribe to both our LinkedIn and our YouTube pages. You will read and watch how so much good happens here!! Please enjoy our summer highlights in this newsletter. I wish you and your family a happy and, healthy rest of the summer.

Staff Spotlight

Our Staff Shines Brightly in the Spotlight

Throughout the year, we love to amplify our work through interviews and success stories. Our blog page features include program information as well as issues of local, state and national importance in our sector. In the links below, please enjoy getting to know two of our dedicated, talented and passionate employees: Lucille Kelly and Julio Vargas. They certainly know how to let their light shine at Jawonio.

Thank you to our amazing summer staff who brought their love, compassion and skills to inspiring our students every day for six weeks of magical moments and memories. Check out our album for all of the smiles!

Community Partnerships

M and T Bank

Jawonio has been so fortunate to have wonderful community partners throughout the years. Thank you M&T Bank for your volunteer efforts in beautifying our Moskoff Home in West Haverstraw. Your work in providing new plantings and landscaping, will continue to enhance the quality of life for our residents to enjoy throughout the seasons. Thank you!

We are thrilled to have just launched a brand new Free Zoom Series from our Autism Resource and Training Center. Join us every Wednesday night at 7pm now through November. If you cannot attend the live presentations, you will be able to watch each session on our YouTube Channel following the event. Don’t miss out!

Congratulations to our 2024 Honorees:Sabrina HoSang Jordan and Patrick Heaphy

Be the reason someone smiles today, with your monthly gift

With your gift of just $15 a month, $180 annually, or a gift of your choice, you will make an immediate difference in the lives of your loved ones and the children and adults receiving our miraculous services. Your donations will directly benefit individual activities for enjoyment, exploration and engagement in the areas of music, art, recreation, wellness and social connections. If you are already a monthly sustainer, or have increased your monthly gift, we thank you. Make a gift today to ensure the Jawonio Foundation is strong and sustainable for individuals and families who will need us today and for years to come.

We provide care for thousands of children and adults with special needs each year.

Jawonio is dedicated to advancing the independence, well-being, and equality of people with disabilities and special needs.

Jawonio is a registered 501c3 organization and the premier provider of lifespan services in the Hudson Valley of New York State.

title: Gerente de Infraestrutura
description:
O Grupo Carrera está em busca de um profissional dinâmico e experiente para ocupar o cargo de Gerente de Infraestrutura.
Este é um papel fundamental para garantir a eficiência e a segurança das operações de TI da empresa.
O candidato ideal deverá ser responsável por liderar e gerenciar as equipes de infraestrutura, garantir a implementação e manutenção de sistemas robustos e seguros, além de otimizar processos e garantir a conformidade com as normas de segurança.
Você será o responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar projetos de infraestrutura, incluindo servidores, redes, armazenamento de dados e segurança cibernética.
Será necessário garantir que todos os sistemas operacionais e de rede funcionem de forma eficiente e que os serviços de TI estejam sempre disponíveis.
Além disso, deverá desenvolver e implementar políticas de segurança de dados, monitorar a infraestrutura e realizar auditorias para garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações.
Experiência em gerenciamento de equipes técnicas, liderança de projetos e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia será essencial.
O candidato deverá possuir conhecimentos profundos em tecnologias de infraestrutura, incluindo servidores, redes, virtualização e segurança cibernética.
Certificações como CISM, CISSP ou equivalentes são altamente desejáveis.
Se você é um profissional com uma mentalidade inovadora e uma abordagem estratégica para a gestão de infraestrutura de TI, esta oportunidade é para você.
Junte-se a uma equipe comprometida com a excelência e a inovação, e faça parte de um grupo que valoriza o crescimento profissional e a colaboração.

Apoiaremos seu desenvolvimento contínuo e ofereceremos um ambiente de trabalho desafiador e gratificante.
Venha contribuir para o sucesso do Grupo Carrera!


Estamos há mais de 20 anos no mercado automotivo!
A história do Grupo Carrera teve início em 2002, com a marca Chevrolet em São Paulo.
Em 2014, o grupo deu mais um passo em direção ao crescimento com a Volkswagen, abrindo lojas em Osasco e Alphaville.
Na sequência, em 2015, o grupo foi nomeado Concessionário Nissan, estabelecendo lojas em São Paulo, Vale do Paraíba e Interior.
Em 2019 uma nova nomeação Chevrolet, dessa vez em Brasília, com o desafio de ajudar no processo de recuperação do share da capital do País.
Em 2020, o Grupo Carrera deu um novo passo estratégico ao começar a atuar com a marca Renault, com lojas em São Paulo e Cotia.
De olho na nova perspectiva de veículos híbridos e elétricos, alinhando-se com as demandas crescentes por tecnologias mais sustentáveis, o grupo expande em 2022 com a marca GWM.
Já em 2023 o grupo incorpora a marca de motos Bajaj, fortalecendo sua presença em Brasília e ampliando seu portfólio de produtos para atender às necessidades dos consumidores de duas rodas.
Atualmente, temos mais de 30 lojas do grupo, localizadas na Grande São Paulo e Brasília.
E nosso grupo só cresce: Hoje estamos com 1500 colaboradores!
A matriz fica situada em São Paulo e conta com diversos departamentos internos inovadores, como T.I e Marketing, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Financeiro, Fiscal, Compras/Manutenção e soluções financeiras por meio do setor de F&I. Além disso, o grupo possui Seguradora e Blindadora própria.
Nosso PROPÓSITO é Facilitar o acesso das pessoas a produtos de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Missão: Viabilizar aos nossos clientes a melhor solução de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Visão: Ser reconhecido como um dos maiores grupos de soluções de mobilidade do Brasil, reconhecido pela ética e inovação na prestação de serviços e como referência em local para se trabalhar

• Foco no Cliente

• Cuidado com o colaborador
