title: CEO Newsletter: August 2023
description:
I am pleased to share my August newsletter with you and hope that you and your families are enjoying a great summer with friends and loved ones.

Earlier this month, I celebrated my 5th year at Jawonio and am wrapping up my 3rd year as CEO of this wonderful organization. I am so grateful to be able to work side by side with an incredibly talented and dedicated staff who work tirelessly to support our children and adults with special needs.

I am excited about the future of our agency, and about the growth and innovation that will take place in both Rockland and Westchester. However, without a New York State Budget that secures sustainable funding for us, we will continue to face economic hardships and uncertainty.

That is why we need a stronger and more effective advocacy effort locally and on the state level in preparation for the2024 NYS Legislative Session. Will you join us?

In order for our advocacy efforts to be successful, we need a wealth of voices to be heard locally and in Albany. We need an engaged community as well as the support of our families, friends and supporters. In other words, we need your help!

While we are disappointed in the outcome of the NYS Budget, we are grateful to our NYS elected officials from Rockland and Westchester who supported our requests.

I wanted to share a few of our advocacy highlights:

  • We hosted two NYS Town Halls with members of our Rockland and Westchester Senate and Assembly delegations.
  • I joined with our staff, participants, state and local partners for a rally at the Capitol in Albany.
  • We attended lobby days, signed petitions and provided advocacy messaging on social media.
  • On behalf of the agency, I was interviewed by LOHUD/USA Today; WCBS Radio and News 12.
  • We hosted a legislative debrief meeting with our NYS elected officials in preparation for 2024.

We are told it will be a tough fiscal year and we need your help now more than ever to press for better funding. Together, we will keep Jawonio strong. I hope you will consider joining us for our 2024 Advocacy in Action efforts. Please drop me a note or contact Diana Hess at if you are interested.

Please know that my door is always open to you, our staff, individuals, families and the community. I look forward to hearing from you.

There is a growing excitement and buzz in Valley Cottage since the grand opening of our Brick it Again Lego resale store in March. As you may know, the mission of Brick it Again is to provide opportunities for prevocational, retail skills and employment training for individuals with special needs. Currently, we have six individuals employed at the store who are enjoying their work and learning new skills on a weekly basis. Children of all ages and their families have stopped by to play and purchase Legos.

We are especially grateful to those families and friends in our community who have organized Lego donation drives. Another wonderful way to support the store is by having your birthday party with us. If your child has a birthday coming up, then Brick it Again will make it a special and personalized experience for you. Click here or call . and book your party today.

Parent, Nichole Lande shares her son Caleb's special day

“I want to pass along our heartfelt feedback about the birthday party we had at Brick it Again today. We could not be more pleased! Andrew and Matt were incredible and made sure that every detail went smoothly. On top of that, they were above and beyond engaging and wonderful with the kids!

My son, Caleb, is turning 5 and has been visiting the store weekly for a few months now. Andrew, “Mr. Andrew” as Caleb calls him, has become a friend and mentor to Caleb. He always helps us find just the right piece or new set.

Today’s party just made us fall further in love with your store and the whole program. Thank you for bringing this great venue to our town and my child’s life!”

Our Employees Shine

Beginning this spring, we launched a new feature on our website called “Employee Spotlight”. This regular blog post highlights our incredibly talented and dedicated staff.

Each month, our blog gives us the opportunity to learn more about the people who have chosen Jawonio for their career. It is wonderful to learn about our employees’ backgrounds; where they grew up, their educational path, and how they found Jawonio. There is a thread that weaves its way throughout all of their stories which is a commitment to our mission and the people they support. Visit and enjoy our blog page here .

Summer Excitement for our children, teens and adults

Summers at Jawonio are a community tradition. Beginning in 1947 as “Camp Jawonio”, the Jawonio Summer Education Program continues to provide outstanding academics, as well as art, music and swimming programs that make for the most beautiful days and memories for our children and teens. Everyone is preparing for the “end of summer” musical next week and we can’t wait!!

Summer 2023 has been great for our adult programs too!! Last week, in celebration of Disability Pride Month and the 33rd Anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act, Rye Playland hosted our Rockland and Westchester individuals along with many other agencies around the Hudson Valley Region. Opportunities to enjoy recreational, social and physical activities are wonderful enhancements to our programs and make a difference every day.

Monthly Sustainer Program

The Jawonio Foundation began our monthly sustainer program in 2022. We are so grateful to our almost 70 donors who have joined us in this effort. For $7.50 per month, you will be supporting enhancements to our programs that are not reimbursable to Jawonio. With your gift, our children and adults will have more opportunities and access to social, recreational, creative arts and community based activities throughout the year! Monthly giving is an easy way for you to support our work now and for a sustainable future for all. If you choose to give at the $30 level and above, you will receive a a thank you gift from us for your generosity. Click here and make your tax-deductible contribution today!

More than 130 golfers enjoyed perfect weather and an outstanding experience at Paramount Country Club raising $155,000 dollars at our 35th Annual Jawonio Foundation Golf outing. Thank you to our golf committee who worked tirelessly for six months to ensure the success of this event. Thank you to all of our golfers, sponsors, golf committee and volunteers. We also want to thank our dinner guests and supporters who joined with us for the evening festivities and auction. SAVE THE DATE FOR OUR 36th ANNUAL GOLF OUTING ON Monday, June 3, 2024.

More than 120 bowlers and friends filled the lanes at New City Bowl for our friendly high school vs. high school competition called the Hometown Heroes Bowlathon. This year’s winner was North Rockland HS. Following with a close second and third were the teams from Nyack HS and Nanuet HS respectively. We want to thank everyone who participated in this sold-out event who helped us raise $30,000 for our children and adults. Thank you to our co-chairs, Lon Hofstein and Lou Falco, along with our captains, donors, sponsors and volunteers. Thank you to Alice Lenna and her staff at New City Bowl for hosting us. Click here to see our event sponsor and thank you page. You can join in the fun in 2024 and play for your favorite high school team as an alumni or friend.

SAVE THE DATE for next year’s rock and bowl on Saturday, March 2, 2024.

The Marvin Blume

Employee Scholarship

The Marvin Blume Scholarship is a fund created by parents Ellie and Dan Salmon. The financial award named for Ellie’s father, is presented to a college-bound student whose parent is a Jawonio employee. This year’s winner is Jesse Woodhouse, son of Kristen Woodhouse. Jesse will be attending SUNY Oneonta in the fall. Thank you to our selection committee for their hard work in support of our staff and their loved ones. Thank you to the Salmon Family for your generous annual gift.

It Will Be A

December to Remember

We are delighted to announce our Friends Award Honorees for 2023 – Drumroll Please… This year’s Gala Honorees are Bill Van Slyck, parent and member of our Jawonio Board of Directors and Margo Bohlin, community philanthropist and Associate Broker of Howard Hanna/Rand Realty. Congratulations to our two honorees!! Our livestream event will be hosted by the wonderful Janice Huff, Chief Meteorologist for NBC4NY. To RSVP please clickhere. This 4th annual gala will take place on December 3rd at 11:30am.

Senior Art Director
As a Senior Art Director for one of the largest automotive companies in the world, you’ll lead and inspire visual storytelling by combining deep design expertise with strategic thinking. You’ll partner with copywriters, account managers, creative directors, strategists, and fellow designers to craft compelling, high-impact work across a wide range of formats. A fast and flexible go-getter, you thrive on new opportunities and possess a natural aptitude for collaboration. You maintain exceptionally high standards, elevating the craft of design, visual systems, and art direction , and inspire both yourself and your team to deliver outstanding, on-brand creative solutions.
Your role demands a refined design sensibility, fluency in design principles (typography, layout, color, motion), and a deep understanding of how to bring brand identities to life across digital and physical touchpoints. You’re equally comfortable developing holistic design systems as you are executing pixel-perfect assets. You know how to push visual boundaries while maintaining usability, accessibility, and business impact.
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the visual development of campaigns and projects from concept to execution, ensuring design integrity and brand consistency throughout all deliverables.
  • Shape and uphold high standards of creative excellence, with a keen eye for design craft, visual storytelling, and brand coherence.
  • Confidently present design thinking and creative solutions alongside Creative Directors, clearly articulating design rationale to internal teams and clients.
  • Guide junior designers and external vendors, delivering thoughtful, constructive feedback that sharpens design outcomes and enhances team growth.
  • Translate brand strategy into compelling visual narratives, motion assets, and integrated campaigns with an eye for detail, hierarchy, and clarity.
  • Collaborate with UX, motion, and production teams to create cohesive, multi-format design systems across websites, social media, OOH, and experiential activations.
  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines and visual toolkits, ensuring scalability across global markets and platforms.
  • Push the creative envelope with bold, innovative design solutions that are grounded in strategic goals and audience insights.
  • Maintain a hands-on design approach when needed—proficiently building high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and final assets across platforms.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging design trends, tools, and cultural shifts to ensure work remains relevant, progressive, and competitive.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in graphic design and art direction within advertising, digital marketing, or branding agencies.
  • A portfolio that showcases exceptional design craft, versatility across media, and the ability to bring bold concepts to life with clarity and style.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead the visual direction of large-scale campaigns, digital products, and content series with consistency and creativity.
  • Fluent in core design principles—composition, color theory, typography, grid systems, motion, and interaction design.
  • Experience developing comprehensive brand identity systems and visual standards for integrated campaigns.
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and collaborative tools like Slack, Miro, and Google Workspace.
  • Comfortable working within and evolving existing brand guidelines to ensure freshness and alignment.
  • Experience in the automotive or production industries is highly desired.
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and digital best practices (social, mobile, web).
  • Able to thoughtfully present and defend design decisions to internal and external stakeholders with strategic clarity.

Your Work Style

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a passion for high-quality, polished output.
  • Highly organized and proactive, able to manage timelines while balancing multiple priorities.
  • Naturally collaborative and receptive to feedback, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrates leadership through mentorship, guidance, and a commitment to creative excellence.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

About CDP:
CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

About CDP:
CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.
Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.
Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.
About the Team:
 CDP’s Sales function is responsible for generating sales of CDP products to new customers, as well as renewing existing customers and identifying greenfield opportunities within the existing book of business. The Sales function is market and customer oriented and establishes go-to market strategies that serve key personas across financial corporates, non-financial corporates, and distributors and channels. The Sales function works closely with M&C and Customer Success to deliver a smooth customer experience.
Key relationship management function in market, overseeing the renewals book of business and identifying greenfield opportunities to expand relationships with existing customers.
About this role:
 As a CDP Market Director, you will have dual responsibilities: serving as the Sub-Regional Market Head and leading the Relationship Management function. In your role as Sub-Regional Head, you will be the senior market-facing representative, engaging with customers at the most senior level and representing CDP at events. Additionally, you will operate within a matrixed organizational structure, providing leadership and guidance to the team. Leading the relationship management function, you will oversee renewals, responsible for the custody and cultivation of the existing book of business.
What you will do:
 Manage an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

  • Working with the Talent Attraction team to identify and recruit the right talent to the team
  • Providing focus and direction, through regular 1:1’s, setting clear objectives, providing ongoing, honest feedback, recognition, structured performance and development conversations, and helping with solutions
  • Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members can communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference. Help resolve conflict as appropriate
  • Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to their position
Strategic Growth Planning:
  • Collaborate with the CRO to develop a comprehensive strategic growth plan focused on revenue-generating activities for the region. This plan should align with the overall business objectives and drive sustainable growth
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Foster seamless collaboration among Sales team members (business development and relationship managers), Customer Success teams (under CDO), and Marketing & Communications (under CMO) to ensure an exceptional client experience. This includes facilitating effective communication and coordination across departments.
Net Renewal Rate (NRR) Achievement:
  • Achieve the sub-regional Net Renewal Rate (NRR) budget by providing tactical advice and support to Relationship Management teams. This involves analyzing performance metrics and implementing strategies to improve client retention.
Go-to-Market (GTM) Execution:
  • Execute go-tomarket (GTM) initiatives effectively, ensuring that all activities are aligned with the strategic growth plan and market demands.
External Representation:
  • Represent CDP at key external events, including speaking engagements at conferences. This role requires strong public speaking skills and the ability to articulate CDP's value proposition to diverse audiences.
Market and Competitive Analysis:
  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the competitive landscape, market trends, and client feedback. This includes conducting regular market research and using insights to inform strategic decisions.
Leadership Participation:
  • Actively participate in and contribute to CDP leadership groups. This involves collaborating with senior leaders to shape the organization's strategic direction.
Global System Integration:
  • Ensure CDP's role within the global system by providing local context and aiding in the development of global organizational strategies. This includes sharing regional insights and best practices with global counterparts
Fundraising and Development Support:
  • Support local fundraising and development efforts in alignment with global priorities and strategies. This involves identifying potential funding opportunities and building relationships with key stakeholders.
Regional Strategy Development:
  • Collaborate with other country and regional offices to develop regional strategies and share best practices. This includes fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Behavioural Traits and Values:
  • Embody and promote CDP's core values of moving together, finding solutions, transparency and optimism. These values should guide all interactions and decision-making processes, ensuring a positive and forward-thinking organizational culture.
The types of roles managed might include relationship managers for financial and nonfinancial corporates.
Internal stakeholders include: disclosure request, disclosure, signatory and data delivery, rev ops, M&C, business development colleagues, impact/TL, policy.
External stakeholders include: corporate and nonfinancial corporates.
This role is a budget holder for renewal of corporate and non-financial corporates.
We're looking for:
  • Extensive and proven experience working in commercial organizations in leadership of sales and account management.
  • Proven track record of developing strong strategic client/stakeholder relationships with financial and non-financial corporates.
  • A strong network of contacts you can use to advance the deep and longstanding relationships CDP holds.
  • Proven track record of creating and implementing strategies to deliver on business and/or impact targets.
  • Background in and knowledge of local business, policy, and sustainability culture, with a known reputation in this sector.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Relevant degree qualification or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent in at least one local language

title: Art Director
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a seasoned Art Director to join our growing team on Fortnite. This Art Director will lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary artists, engineers, and designers to help create the future vision of Fortnite. This person will have experience guiding a high-level vision. You will harness a balance of creative thinking with a strong ability to partner and lead teams in developing content for our various projects. By working closely with the Senior Director of Art you will be accountable for identifying and communicating a high-quality visual style. You will also develop a seasonal vision and execute that vision with a team of artists and coach them to do the same.

In this role, you will

  • Be highly creative; Imagine and communicate vision to leadership and the team to develop new content that players will love
  • Collaborate with multiple teams, including Design, Engineering, and Production to develop world-class player experiences and interpret the needs of all development disciplines into final artwork
  • Deliver effective feedback across all art disciplines - concept, modeling, environment, tech art, lighting, VFX, etc.
  • Collaborate with the teams to identify great ideas and steer them through the pipeline
  • Filter multiple sources of analysis and feedback into visual direction for creating new art
  • Think strategically about art and how it informs the player experience
  • Work within the style of our projects with an eye towards driving the Fortnite brand forward

What we're looking for

  • Experience defining and shipping a product-level vision
  • Strong desire to partner with disciplines outside of Art to create a unified vision
  • Clear understanding and value of art team roles in the player experience
  • Experience as a product-level Art Director in a game studio with a deep understanding of art disciplines and their workflows
  • Strong understanding of art fundamentals, multiple art styles, anatomy, appeal, and storytelling
  • Experience supporting and directing artists across multiple disciplines
  • The ability to adapt to and innovate on new styles and techniques
  • Strong collaborative nature to partner with art directors, other discipline leads, and production
  • Strong leadership skills, with an expectation to guide large teams toward a shared vision
  • Experience with effective feedback for outsourcing and contractors

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and mange various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and -long term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consultdirectly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.

  • An advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.

title: Especialista aponta setores promissores para empreender em 2025
description:
Especialista aponta setores promissores para empreender em 2025

Mercado pet, bem-estar e produtos personalizados estão em alta, aponta analista do Sebrae

Ao longo de dez anos, o número de salões para pets no Brasil mais que dobrou, e o mercado continua crescendo bastante. (Foto: Sebrae/Divulgação)

O cenário para o empreendedorismo brasileiro em 2025 mostra-se promissor, sobretudo em três frentes principais: mercado pe t, saúde e bem-estar e produtos manuais personalizados.

Dados do Sebrae Pernambuco evidenciam que a atividade econômica no estado é aquecida pelos pequenos negócios, com 636,2 mil empresas ativas em 2025, sendo 93,6% delas de menor porte. Em 2024, o setor de serviços teve crescimento anual superior a 3,9%, com destaque para o comércio, com crescimento de 6,4%.

Segundo o analista do Sebrae, Eduardo Leopoldo, o mercado pet tem crescido ano a ano, sendo uma opção tanto para quem possui mais recursos para investir, quanto para pessoas que têm pouco dinheiro, mas desejam entrar no mundo dos negócios.

Leopoldo aponta que serviços como banho e tosa, cuidador de animais domésticos (Pet Sitter) e comércio de rações e acessórios são alternativas viáveis e acessíveis, especialmente para quem inicia como Microempreendedor Individual (MEI).

Na área de saúde e bem-estar, a tendência é semelhante. “Cada vez mais os consumidores estão em busca de uma alimentação mais saudável e natural, sendo uma ótima oportunidade de negócio”, explica o analista. A venda e entrega de alimentos saudáveis e funcionais, assim como serviços como maquiagem, design de sobrancelhas e “nails” design, por exemplo, podem ser iniciados com estrutura mínima.

Outro destaque, segundo o Sebrae, está na personalização, já que o consumidor está cada vez mais exigente e em busca de produtos únicos. Assim, surge a oportunidade no segmento de negócios manuais e artesanais, onde é possível abrir uma loja online com um nicho específico, como velas aromáticas e decorativas, produtos reciclados, crochê, todos personalizados para atender aos desejos dos clientes.

Digitalização como motor de crescimento
A presença digital é um fator que o Sebrae considera indispensável para os pequenos negócios, já que permite a criação de atividades sem estruturas físicas e todas as burocracias e custos vinculados aos negócios físicos como alvarás, licenças de funcionamento, aluguel e impostos.

No entanto, apesar das facilitações das redes, Leopoldo pontua que planejamento e controle de estoques são fundamentais para manter a escalabilidade e evitar frustrações nos atendimentos online.

Oferecer boa experiência é essencial

Dentre os pequenos negócios de sucesso, uma característica em comum é a qualidade da experiência do consumidor online e para isso são necessárias ações mais específicas. "Presença digital assertiva, como redes sociais com características profissionais, boa estratégia de tráfego pago e orgânico, ter um trabalho especializado e qualidade no atendimento", enumera o analista do Sebrae, Eduardo Leopoldo.

Segundo o analista, na experiência do cliente, um atendimento ágil e cortês também é um diferencial. Além disso, ele ensina que é necessário considerar o tempo de resposta adequado: de cinco a seis horas.

Além disso, sustentabilidade, personalização, agilidade e experiência de compra são fatores cada vez mais determinantes na decisão do consumidor. “Cada vez mais o consumidor busca o consumo de empresas mais sustentáveis, que possuem preocupação com o meio ambiente. Também os consumidores buscam não mais apenas adquirir um produto ou serviço, mas a experiência de compra é cada vez mais valorizada”, observa o analista.

Ele sugere que pequenos empreendedores adotem práticas sustentáveis, como o uso de embalagens biodegradáveis, e comuniquem bem seus diferenciais nas redes sociais. “Nem todo perfil de consumidor é semelhante e entender seu segmento, seu tipo de público (faixa etária, gênero, classe econômica, etc.) faz toda diferença para ser assertivo”, explica.

Mesmo em setores promissores, muitos empreendedores acabam cometendo falhas graves que comprometem o sucesso do negócio, segundo o Sebrae. O analista do Sebrae, Eduardo Leopoldo, aponta como exemplos dessas “falhas graves” o fato de não fazer um planejamento adequado, não entender quem é e onde está seu público, não dividir as finanças pessoais das finanças do negócio, não saber precificar e ter a falsa ideia de lucro de 100%.

Além disso, o especialista alerta para a importância do bom atendimento. Um atendimento inadequado, demorado, sem uma experiência positiva, também afasta o cliente. “O tempo de resposta adequado (após o cliente entrar em contato), por exemplo, deve ser de cinco a seis horas durante o horário comercial”, diz.


Para quem deseja empreender ainda em 2025, o conselho de Leopoldo é claro: atenção ao cenário, estudo do público, presença digital e, sobretudo, planejamento. “É isso que pode transformar uma boa ideia em um negócio sustentável”, finaliza o analista.

title: Advogado Sênior (EUDR)
description:
Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Consultoria Jurídica:

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.

Contencioso:

  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.

Compliance:

  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligenceem direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders, gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

Key Performance Indicators ( KPIs)

A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.

Organizar e divulgar as regras de segurança corporativas

Participar de reuniões de planejamento, realizar inspeções de campo nas áreas da empresa, verificar as condições de trabalho e de segurança, efetuar análises de riscos e ocorrências de HSE, orientar quanto a adequada utilização dos recursos de saúde e segurança do trabalho, sugerir e apoiar na implementação de medidas preventivas e/ou corretivas, visando resguardar a integridade física dos colaboradores, a prevenção de acidentes de trabalhos e fortalecer a cultura de saúde e segurança do trabalho

Descrição da Empresa

A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.
Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.
  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;
  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.
  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.
  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.
  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.
  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.
  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.
  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.
  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.
ABOUT ERM:
Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients. We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.
For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.
At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.
If you would like to read more about Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging
 (DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, operating over 260 data centers across the globe. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners, and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world-class experiences, and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.

Our culture is based on collaboration and the growth and development of our teams. We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Linux Infrastructure Senior Specialist to work in critical and high-performance environments, focusing on infrastructure support for critical environments and projects, including Artificial Intelligence.

Responsibilities

  1. Administer Linux environments (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, and Suse), ensuring high availability and performance.
  2. Support infrastructure that serves AI and Machine Learning workloads, including configuring environments with GPU support (NVIDIA, CUDA).
  3. Perform advanced troubleshooting, performance analysis, and provide second and third level technical support.
  4. Collaborate with global teams, participate in meetings, and deliver technical solutions in English.
  5. Conduct root cause analysis of incidents.
  6. Produce documentation related to the environment (RCA, KBs, etc.).
  7. Standardize environments by acting on incidents and requests relating to their specialty.
  8. Plan and implement changes, migrations, and improvements based on a change plan.
  9. Collect information on managed environments to meet internal demands.
  10. Maintain and update documentation related to the client's production environment.
  11. Operate, maintain, and document customer equipment with a management product (Managed Services) following policy.
  12. Identify opportunities for improvement and new business opportunities.
  13. Analyze the production environment to propose improvements.
  14. Provide telephone support for incidents, requests, and change preparations.
  15. Support first-level service teams with technical guidance or escalate demands.
  16. Participate in planning and implementing HPC solutions, software integration, and system administration for new clients.

Qualifications

Position Summary:

The IT Compliance & Application Security Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating IT compliance initiatives, with a strong focus on Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and cybersecurity requirements. This role ensures that IT controls are effectively designed, documented, and executed in alignment with regulatory standards and audit expectations.
This position plays a critical role in identifying risks, implementing cybersecurity best practices, and maintaining a robust control environment across both financial and non-financial systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Control Framework Ownership Develop and maintain application-specific control matrices (e.g., SoD, secure development, identity lifecycle, privileged access). Ensure alignment with frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, and NIST.

Policy Implementation & Oversight Translate enterprise security policies into actionable control requirements. Ensure consistent implementation across centralized (e.g., SAP GRC) and decentralized platforms.

Partner with internal software development teams to promote secure coding practices and integrate security checkpoints within CI/CD pipelines.

IAM & SoD Governance Develop governance over identity provisioning, role design, and segregation of duties enforcement. Coordinate exceptions and remediation plans in collaboration with IAM and audit teams.

Metrics & Reporting Define and report on KPIs/KRIs related to control effectiveness and risk posture. Deliver dashboards and reports to senior leadership and risk committees.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with application owners, cybersecurity architects, GRC analysts, and vendors to ensure compliance coverage.

Policies, Procedures, and Documentation Develop and maintain IT compliance policies and procedures. Ensure documentation meets audit standards and reflects current operations.

Education, and training, develop and train application and system owners on their responsibilities and self-assessment for security controls.

IT Controls & Frameworks Deep knowledge of ITGCs, application controls, and frameworks (COSO, COBIT, NIST). Experience in change management, access management, and system operations.

Audit Methodologies & Standards Familiarity with PCAOB, ISACA, and other audit standards. Experience working with internal/external auditors (Big Four experience is a plus).

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge Strong understanding of SOX (especially Section 404), GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS.

GRC Tools Proficiency in SAP GRC and other GRC platforms for control monitoring and reporting.

Cybersecurity Fundamentals Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, incident response, and vulnerability management.

Data Analysis & Reporting Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and audit findings. Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools for reporting.

Interpersonal Skills:

Collaboration & Teamwork: Effective cross-functional collaboration.

Communication: Clear articulation of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Leadership & Influence: Ability to drive compliance initiatives and gain organizational buy-in.

Adaptability: Flexibility in navigating regulatory and technological changes.

Strategic Thinking: Alignment of compliance efforts with business objectives.

Proactive Mindset: Anticipation of risks and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in IT compliance, audit, or cybersecurity roles.

Core Competencies:

  • Courageous
  • Trustworthy
  • Business Savvy
  • Operational Excellence

The Senior Sales Engineer role at Infinite Lambda is designed for a technical leader who bridges sales and engineering, driving growth in a fast-growing consultancy focused on data and AI solutions. LOCATION & WORK ARRANGEMENT

PROSPECTIVE CLIENT ENGAGEMENT

  • Understand and document client needs, articulating how Infinite Lambda’s products and services can address these needs effectively;
  • Collaborate with the sales team to drive a collaborative approach, creating compelling proposals that align with client expectations;
  • Conduct and facilitate technical deep-dive workshops with prospective clients to showcase capabilities and gather insights, using workshop outputs to strengthen proposals;
  • Identify relevant Infinite Lambda products and services, working with the sales team to position them strategically for each opportunity;
  • Assist both the sales and delivery teams in estimating project scope, effort, and resources, producing realistic and commercially viable account strategies. This includes defining initial team composition, tools to utilise, and a high-level roadmap.
LEAD SALES ENGINEER STRATEGY
  • Work with departments such as Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships to clearly define roles and responsibilities, ensuring seamless collaboration across functions;
  • Collaborate with Product & Services to stay informed about existing offerings and influence product roadmaps, helping design new products and services based on client feedback and market trends;
  • Enhance the positioning of Infinite Lambda’s products and services during the sales process and beyond, improving how value is communicated to clients;
  • Liaise with senior leadership (CEO, CTO, CPO, COO, CSO) at Infinite Lambda to formulate a clear strategy for combining data and cloud expertise into a holistic value proposition, strengthening the company’s market positioning;
  • Conduct regular research on industry trends, working with leadership to evolve strategies as appropriate to maintain competitiveness;
  • Deepen subject-matter knowledge in Infinite Lambda’s key industry verticals, ensuring a strong understanding of client needs and market dynamics.
SOUTH AMERICA EXPANSION
  • Partner with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to identify and establish delivery hubs in South America, supporting the company’s growth strategy in the region;
  • Actively participate in hiring efforts for the new hubs, and be physically present onsite to help set up team culture, fostering a positive and collaborative environment. This responsibility is timeboxed or milestone-based, such as a fixed duration of 6 months or until the first 15 hires are onboarded, as mutually agreed;
  • Ensure the expansion aligns with Infinite Lambda’s mission and values, contributing to long-term success in the region.
Additional Duties
  • Work with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to help steer the company’s overall strategy in a positive direction, providing insights from sales engineering perspectives.
  • Represent Infinite Lambda at external conferences and events, promoting the company’s brand, thought leadership, and expertise in data and cloud engineering.
Requirements
  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is preferred;
  • Experience: A proven track record in sales engineering or technical sales, preferably within the data, cloud, or technology sectors, with significant leadership experience;
  • Technical expertise: experience in data engineering, analytics engineering and data scientist roles and related technologies, such as AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, dbt and machine learning frameworks is essential;
  • Data architecture: Stream processing and batch data warehouse processing, event-driven architecture, micro services, DataOps and MLOps practices;

  • Leadership and strategy: Experience in leading sales engineering teams or functions, with a strategic mindset to influence company direction and market expansion;
  • Collaboration: Strong ability to work effectively across different departments and levels, fostering collaboration with Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships;
  • Market expansion: Experience in international markets or expanding into new regions is a plus, particularly knowledge of South American markets and business practices, which is desirable for this role.

description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to direct the technical approach and execution for a main internal project in the Fortnite ecosystem. They will be responsible for driving several engineering teams to be capable of meeting any technical challenge that may arise, curating the staffing levels across the various engineering specializations, providing critical technical insight and feedback, and supporting project planning from the engineering perspective. They will align project technical decisions to lead the project engineering team from the idea to a successful live online multiplayer game.

In this role, you will

Have the ability to align disparate audiences, both clarifying complex technical issues for non-engineering stakeholders and translating the needs of production and marketing for low-level developers

Be able to articulate challenges, risks, and trade-offs in a constructive way

Ensure feature request requirements are clear, consistent, and achievable

Regularly manage and mentor engineering leads and individual contributors

Communicate cross-discipline with Design, Art, UI, and Production to understand the goals and requirements of features to be implemented

Work with the engineering Leads to establish and refine our development roadmap

Challenge and align technical decisions across disciplines that lead the project to success

What we're looking for

A technical leader who excels at giving feedback and has demonstrated capabilities in facilitating team success

Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms

Experience with the unique challenges of creating and maintaining large-scale, live, online multiplayer games, with a focus on advanced networking, real-time physics, and dynamic, interoperating services

Advanced C++ skills and experience with scripting languages, low-level debugging, and optimization

Impeccable problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

Experience collaborating with and managing relationships with both internal teams and external partners

Deep expertise in the product lifecycle for games, such as generating detailed technical requirements, assembling capable teams, executing said requirements, and building robust support systems to manage them

Experience with Unreal Engine 5

Architecting and building solutions in multiple areas of expertise – Gameplay, Graphics, Audio, UI, Networking, and Physics

Passionate about personal development, taking advantage of opportunities to continuously improve

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ACCOUNTING & FINANCE

What We Do

Our Finance and Accounting teams build the financial infrastructure to scale our growing company. We combine analytical and strategic thinking to develop a sound financial future for our global brand. We work closely with teams across the company, international subsidiaries, as well as with external partners to ensure a world-class finance organization. Our team contains experts from fields like tax, treasury, purchasing, FP&A, and more.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a General Ledger Accountant to join our growing Brazil Finance team. This role is to be based in Brazil. You will work alongside existing members of the Brazil Finance team and partner with them and others within Epic to provide day-to-day accounting and transitional assistance, deliver high-quality financial reporting, and support ad hoc finance-related projects for Epic Brazil. This will enable us to provide complete and accurate financial reporting to the US and the United Kingdom. The role will take responsibility for building best in class reporting and control structures to ensure that Epic’s financial and operational performance is optimized, scalable and clearly communicated on a timely and accurate basis.

In this role, you will

  • Be responsible for the management of the financial accounting, including accrual and provision calculations and postings, reconciliations and financial closing activities (monthly and yearly)
  • Financial accounting Reporting for Epic UK and US
  • Management of the annual statutory audit
  • Collaborate regarding system and process enhancements
  • Fixed asset accounting and administration (including depreciation, asset tracking, and leases)
  • Tax declarations, statistical report preparation and submissions
  • Be the point of contact for any accounting or transactional queries from the Business

What we're looking for

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, any other languages are appreciated
  • 3-5 years recent and relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting. With Active CRC
  • Strong knowledge of General Ledger accounting processes and procedures, ERP systems (Senior Sistemas and Workday are preferable) and MS Excel - Google Sheets is a plus
  • Experience dealing with External Auditor requests
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a timely manner
  • Attention to detail, organization and experience in a fast-paced environment

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Head of Marketing & Communications, Brazil to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Marketing & Communications

How you will create an impact

Reporting to the Head Marketing and Communications, Latin America and Caribbean, and to the GM for Brazil, this role has accountability of marketing and communications strategy, internal communications, content marketing, events, media relations and sales enablement in support of AIG Brazil.

The role will be responsible for establishing processes, best practices, and strategic business marketing and communications plans in support of AIG Brazil – including distribution engagement programs targeted to clients, brokers and partners; our events program, product/solutions marketing, differentiated knowledge leadership, attributable content marketing, and alignment with distribution to deliver AIG’s full capabilities to the market. This role is also responsible for developing and implementing strategic communications plans, encompassing external, internal and leadership communications, media relations and knowledge leadership to AIG’s stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead an integrated marketing and communications team, creating alignment and consistency in Marketing & Communications strategy and messaging, strengthening capabilities, and driving a culture of high performance to deliver sustainable, high-quality services.
  • Mentor and develop team members about core marketing and communications disciplines including audience targeting and segmentation, customer value propositions, business development, pipeline management, media relations, event management, industry events, campaign planning, and KPI/ROI reporting;
  • Provide guidance and oversight of marketing and communications plans and budgets aligned with AIG Brazil business priorities;
  • Develop best practices for demand-driven event marketing, knowledge leadership, content marketing and social media campaigns that facilitate sales growth;
  • Closely partner with Brazil business and functional leaders to promote and sustain a consistent AIG brand identity across businesses;
  • Manage Brazil business and industry media relations, including news releases and interviews, speaking opportunities, and issues and crisis management communications in coordination with AIG corporate teams;
  • Oversight and governance of external vendor engagement

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Significant experience in marketing and communications strategy development, execution and team leadership
  • Thorough knowledge of marketing and communications principles, product/service management, sales enablement and business development
  • Demonstrated ability to manage media relations, crisis management and corporate social responsibility efforts
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing communications and PR, content production, technology platforms and sponsorship/event management
  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling and in developing compelling and segmented narratives for key internal and external stakeholder groups
  • Ability to produce high-quality, high-volume deliverables in a dynamic environment, effectively aligning Country Marketing & Communications strategies and activities
  • Significant prior experience managing complex projects across geographies, businesses, products and segments;
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate meaningful working relationships as a trusted and influential advisor to senior executives, and to deliver within a global matrixed environment;
  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, driving high levels of performance and build a pipeline of talent within the function;
  • Experience within the Insurance, broader Financial Services or regulated sectors preferred;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, preferably also Spanish

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

title: Pessoa Analista de Compras Sênior
description:
Profissional responsável por gerenciar e conduzir processos estratégicos e operacionais de compras, assegurando a otimização de custos, qualidade dos produtos e serviços adquiridos e a eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos. Atua estrategicamente na negociação, homologação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, buscando inovação, mitigação de riscos e excelência operacional.

Atuação está diretamente ligada ao cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e compliance, garantindo que as aquisições sejam feitas de forma sustentável e alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar processos de compras, incluindo a elaboração de RFI (Request for Information), RFQ (Request for Quotation) e RFP (Request for Proposal) para garantir competitividade e transparência.
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de compras, desde a identificação da necessidade até a entrega e pagamento, garantindo que os processos sigam as diretrizes da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos, assegurando qualidade, confiabilidade e competitividade.
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e auditorias a fornecedores, garantindo conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos.
  • Negociar cláusulas contratuais e elaborar contratos comerciais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, custos e qualidade dos produtos e serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM), garantindo relacionamento saudável e de longo prazo com fornecedores.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, oscilações de preços e riscos econômicos (como variação cambial, custo de matérias-primas e inflação).
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e maximização de eficiência operacional, aplicando conceitos como TCO (Custo total por propriedade) e should cost analysis (Custo x Benefício).
  • Assegurar a conformidade dos processos de compras com as normas fiscais, tributárias e auditorias aplicáveis.
  • Utilizar dashboards e ferramentas analíticas (Power BI, Excel avançado, Tableau) para suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Aplicar metodologias Lean e Six Sigma para redução de desperdícios e melhoria contínua dos processos de suprimentos.
  • Monitorar os níveis de estoque e consumo, propondo estratégias de compras just-in-time (JIT) para redução de custos e otimização de armazenagem.
  • Planejar e gerenciar operações de importação e desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo conformidade regulatória e eficiência no tempo de entrega.
  • Analisar o impacto logístico das aquisições, incluindo fretes, armazenagem e modais de transporte.
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento orçamentário da área de compras, garantindo alinhamento financeiro e previsibilidade.
  • Promover inovação na cadeia de suprimentos, buscando novas tecnologias e fornecedores que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Demais atividades inerentes da função.

title: Character Concept Artist (IP)
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Character Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As a Concept Artist, you will work with the development teams to create memorable and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in character design will provide the inspiration to continue pushing the boundaries of what Fortnite means to our players.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Produce unique, memorable, and compelling characters that fit the Fortnite style
  • Create character designs in a variety of body shapes, race, and aesthetics
  • Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of Epic quality bar, and create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior Concept Artist role
  • Experience working with intellectual properties
  • A portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity, and craftsmanship
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

ART

Epic is looking for an experienced FX Art Lead to join our team working on Fortnite. A successful candidate should have a strong sense of dramatic effects and an understanding of how to recreate them in a real time particle editor. They will be first and foremost a team player, while also having the ability to be self-motivated and work autonomously. If you have a strong sense of weight, timing, motion, and you demonstrate technical aptitude with Materials and Logic, we are ready for you to bring those abilities to execute outstanding FX in our games.

Lead a growing team of effects artists, mentor and coach artists you work with

Collaborate with other discipline teams to produce cohesive game experience

Partner with external vendors, onboard and support production of FX outside of Epic Games

Drive the style and feel of Fortnite’s FX

Work closely with the production on the schedule to deliver the FX in a timely manner

What we’re looking for

Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed Real-Time FX work

Critical eye for the timing, animation, and motion of real-world objects and visual FX with an ability to bring dramatic FX to life with a flair

Good instincts for realistic and stylized FX

Ability to create all art needed for the FX

Experience in VFX (games or film) is a must. Shipped AAA game titles is a plus

Familiarity with UE5 or other real-time engine art pipelines is a big plus

If you have a portfolio/reel/website you'd like to share, please hyperlink it to your resume, or submit it as an attachment with your application. (OPTIONAL - art roles only)

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.
