description:
Company Description

This vacancy is open for CSCA auditors in Latin America and USA. At QIMA, we’re on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust.

Working with over 30,000 global brands, retailers, manufacturers and food growers, we are on the ground wherever products are made. We help businesses secure every step of their supply chain with quality inspections, supplier audits, certifications, and lab testing, all powered by our intelligent digital platform.

Our team of 5,000 QIMers (and counting) across 40 offices and laboratories, are united in our shared passion for innovation and integrity, and guided by our QIMA values in the decisions we make every day. We believe in the work we do, and in making a positive difference in the world. Does this sound like something you’d like to be a part of?

Our Consumer Goods Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, and lab techs use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.

Our operations department’s purpose is to deliver our industry-leading services to our clients while ensuring that all the work we do is performed to the QIMA standard of quality.

Job Description

This vacancy is open for CSCA auditors in Latin America and the EU.

You Will Be Expected To

  • Audit the manufacturing sites of our clients’ suppliers, sometimes without warning. Your areas of attention will include labor rights, health and safety, environmental security, and others, according to the applicable international standard or the client’s in-house procedure.
  • Be alert to any violations, staying vigilant when dealing with factory management, and recording all your findings in detailed reports, to be delivered to the client.
  • Approach your job with utmost integrity, as your conduct during an audit can have lasting consequences for the supplier, factory staff, and our clients.

We May Also Request You To

  • Provide your expertise in client meetings, to create custom quality control procedures based on their specific requirements.
  • Contribute your ideas for improving the quality of our Operations projects.

Qualifications

It could be you, if you have:

  • A higher education degree in Engineering, Law, Economics, Social Sciences or a related major.
  • APSCA registered at CSCA level (Mandatory).
  • Strong knowledge of SA8000/ISO14001/ICTI/C-TPAT/WRAP/BSCI.
  • Work experience in 3rd party auditing.
  • Experience in Environmental Audit.
  • SMETA/BSCI/SA8000/WRAP or mixed audits done in recent 12 months.
  • Have good command of English and Spanish (spoken and written).

Additional Information

This vacancy is open for CSCA auditors in Latin America and USA.

The successful candidate will report to the Sr. Director, Legal – Litigation and work closely with the Litigation Team and key business stakeholders to provide high-quality legal advice, primarily in the areas of product liability litigation, complex commercial disputes, warranty matters, and class actions. The successful candidate must be a team player with a demonstrated history of working collaboratively and effectively with an experienced group of lawyers and paralegals. The successful candidate also will be expected to independently manage an active caseload, strategically direct outside counsel and consultants, and skillfully advise internal business colleagues. Meaningful experience in all aspects of complex product liability, warranty, and class action litigation is required. The ideal candidate also will possess strong leadership and managerial courage, emotional intelligence and maturity, an appropriate sense of urgency, and excellent business partnership and relationship-building skills. A passion for the outdoors and an aptitude or interest in mechanical/engineering problem-solving is also highly desired.

  • Efficiently manage portions of the company’s complex pre-litigation and litigation matters, including matters involving product liability, warranty, commercial, and class action cases and other litigated matters in a manner that reflects internal priorities and protects company interests.
  • Confidently communicate with internal business stakeholders regarding litigated matters, process improvements, and other matters.
  • Independently and effectively manage and oversee outside counsel.
  • Negotiate litigation settlements and represent Polaris at mediations and trials.
  • Lead and contribute to process-improvement projects in support of the Legal Department’s mission and initiatives.
  • Develop and provide training to corporate colleagues on a variety of legal issues.
  • Monitor, review, and resolve day-to-day legal and regulatory issues as they are assigned.
Skills & Knowledge
  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school.
  • Licensed and in good standing to practice law in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to become licensed in Minnesota.
  • 6-10 years of significant litigation experience either in-house or at a law firm, in the areas of product liability, class actions, or complex commercial litigation.
  • Confident team player with attorney and non-attorney legal professionals and business partners. Ability to manage, mentor, and direct paralegals in a collaborative setting.

Head of Payment Product - LATAM

We are looking for a product leader to shape the future of Payment Methods in LATAM.

As Head of Payment Product for LATAM, you will own the strategy, vision, and execution for Adyen’s core payments products in one of our most dynamic and high-growth regions. You’ll be responsible for defining what great looks like for Payment Methods in the region, aligning teams behind that vision, and delivering measurable impact to our customers and the business.

You will build and develop a team of high-performing Product Managers, raise the bar for product thinking, and take full ownership of the regional product portfolio. You are accountable for simplifying the product landscape, driving performance and adoption, and delivering real value to customers. What you’ll do:

Foster a culture of ownership, customer centricity, and measurable outcomes. Ensure the team aligns with Adyen’s strategic goals and supports regional and global objectives.
  • Product Simplification & Optimization: Streamline the regional product portfolio to reduce complexity, improve reliability, and accelerate adoption. Drive clarity on what we stop, start, and scale based on customer impact and business value.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with commercial, engineering, partnerships, and compliance teams to bring products to market, improve performance, and solve hard problems.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years in product management, with 5+ years leading PMs. You’ve built high-performing teams and shipped complex products.

  • You’ve built and scaled products across multiple markets.
  • You are customer-centric and data-driven, always anchored in impact.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . This role is based out of our São Paulo office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

The way we work is guided by the eight principles of the Adyen Formula. Learn more here.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Datenschutz bei Bewerbungen und im Bewerbungsverfahren
Der für die Verarbeitung Verantwortliche erhebt und verarbeitet die personenbezogenen Daten von Bewerbern zum Zwecke der Abwicklung des Bewerbungsverfahrens. Dies ist insbesondere dann der Fall, wenn ein Bewerber entsprechende Bewerbungsunterlagen auf dem elektronischen Wege, beispielsweise per E-Mail oder über ein auf der Internetseite befindliches Webformular, an den für die Verarbeitung Verantwortlichen übermittelt. Schließt der für die Verarbeitung Verantwortliche einen Anstellungsvertrag mit einem Bewerber, werden die übermittelten Daten zum Zwecke der Abwicklung des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses unter Beachtung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften gespeichert. Wird von dem für die Verarbeitung Verantwortlichen kein Anstellungsvertrag mit dem Bewerber geschlossen, so werden die Bewerbungsunterlagen zwei Monate nach Bekanntgabe der Absageentscheidung automatisch gelöscht, sofern einer Löschung keine sonstigen berechtigten Interessen des für die Verarbeitung Verantwortlichen entgegenstehen. Sonstiges berechtigtes Interesse in diesem Sinne ist beispielsweise eine Beweispflicht in einem Verfahren nach dem Allgemeinen Gleichbehandlungsgesetz (AGG).

  • Padronizar protocolos assistenciais com apoio da equipe multidisciplinar, promovendo unificação de condutas e fluxos;

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN;
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão em Saúde, Qualidade ou áreas afins (desejável);

  • Conhecimento em dimensionamento de equipe, gestão de pessoas e indicadores assistenciais.

Ética
Sem isso, não tem nem conversa. Com esse pilar, tudo o que queremos construir será sólido, duradouro e verdadeiro. Fazemos o que é correto.
Desafiar o status quo
Dá para fazer diferente? Sempre dá. E pode ser simples. Temos paixão por transformar e evoluir.

Aqui ninguém ganha sozinho. Quando uma pessoa erra, o outro arredonda a bola. É uma relação de ganha-ganha.

Além de realizar a aplicação de protocolos de estética e bem-estar, os profissionais técnicos do Buddha Spa são responsáveis por proporcionar uma experiência de bem-estar completa, atuando em todos os aspectos do atendimento e experiência do cliente dentro da cabine.

Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional passa por um processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para atuar de acordo com o padrão de excelência da marca.

Horário de trabalho: O profissional atua em média 7 horas por dia, com uma folga fixa durante a semana e um sábado de folga fixo. Aos domingos, o trabalho é por escala, geralmente dois domingos por mês.

Contratação: Contrato de parceria via Lei do Salão Parceiro (Lei 13.352/2016). É necessário abrir um MEI/CNPJ.

Remuneração: Repartição de resultados dos atendimentos, com porcentagem sobre os procedimentos realizados.

Plano de crescimento e benefícios: Incentivos e benefícios variam conforme o tempo de parceria e crescimento na escala de desenvolvimento:

  • Bronze – 20%
  • Prata – 25%
  • Ouro – 30%
  • Diamante – 35%

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e locais, buscando sempre proximidade com os clientes, em imóveis de rua, hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias.

Focamos em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecendo mais de 25 terapias, incluindo massagens, banhos, tratamentos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos específicos para público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.

A essência do Buddha Spa está no valor do "sentir-se bem" em todos os aspectos. Nosso objetivo é proporcionar uma experiência única, despertando os cinco sentidos, com infraestrutura de alto padrão, sons, aromas e chás que complementam o toque profissional de nossos terapeutas.

Descrição da vaga
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Brasilia (BSB)!
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa
As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)
As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)
As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Proatividade;
  • Vontade de aprender;
  • Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Disciplina e organização;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para trabalhar em turnos rotativos presenciais;
Informações adicionais
Todos os envios de CV devem vir obrigatoriamente acompanhados do "LAUDO CARACTERIZADOR DE DEFICIÊNCIA". De acordo com o Decreto 3.298/1999 e com a Instrução Normativa SIT/ MTE n.º 98 de 15/08/2012, observados os dispositivos da Convenção sobre os Direitos das Pessoas com deficiência, Lei 12764/12, Lei13146/2015.
